```{r}
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 3.   Function to calculate correlation for select annotation 
##      plots in circos plot
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
plot_annotation_circos <- function(cor_mat, annot_name, output_path) {

  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 1. Prepare sample metadata
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  # Extract all sample names from the correlation matrix
  sector_names <- union(rownames(cor_mat), colnames(cor_mat))

  # Assign each sample to a cell type or origin
  sample_meta <- tibble(sample = sector_names) %>%
    mutate(geno_membership = case_when(
      str_detect(sample, "_iN") ~ "iN",
      str_detect(sample, "_iDA") ~ "iDA",
      str_detect(sample, "\\.KO$") ~ "HeLa",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ))

  # Define color scheme for sample types
  celltype_colors <- c("iN" = "dodgerblue", "iDA" = "#D53E4F", "HeLa" = "grey76")

  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 2. Create edge list from correlation matrix
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  link_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_mat)) %>%
    rename(from = Var1, to = Var2, correlation = Freq) %>%
    mutate(from = as.character(from), to = as.character(to)) %>%
    filter(from != to) %>%
    mutate(pair_id = map2_chr(from, to, ~ paste(sort(c(.x, .y)), collapse = "_"))) %>%
    distinct(pair_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(-pair_id)

  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 3. Define color gradient for correlation strength
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  corr_palette <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu"))
  corr_values  <- seq(-0.6, 0.6, length.out = 11)
  col_fun <- colorRamp2(corr_values, corr_palette)

  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 4. Filter edges by threshold and prepare sample order
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  # Keep only strong correlations
  plot_links <- link_df %>%
    filter(correlation < -0.3 | correlation > 0.3)

  if (nrow(plot_links) == 0) {
  message("No correlations pass threshold for annotation: ", annot_name)
  return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Collect samples participating in selected edges
  samples_in_plot <- union(plot_links$from, plot_links$to)

  # Filter and order metadata for plotting
  ordered_sample_meta <- sample_meta %>%
    filter(sample %in% samples_in_plot) %>%
    arrange(geno_membership, sample)

  ordered_samples <- ordered_sample_meta$sample
  ordered_membership <- ordered_sample_meta$geno_membership
  sector_colors <- setNames(celltype_colors[ordered_membership], ordered_samples)
  celltype_ring_colors <- sector_colors
  
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 5. Compute spacing between sectors
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  gap_between_sectors <- 1
  gap_between_groups  <- 10

  group_counts <- ordered_sample_meta %>%
    dplyr::count(geno_membership, name = "n") %>%
    pull(n)

  gap_after <- unlist(lapply(group_counts, function(n) {
    c(rep(gap_between_sectors, n - 1), gap_between_groups)
  }))
  gap_after[length(gap_after)] <- 0  # no trailing gap

  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 6. Draw circos plot
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  pdf(output_path, width = 10, height = 12)
  circos.clear()
  circos.par(start.degree = 90, gap.after = gap_after)

  chordDiagram(
    x = plot_links,
    grid.col = sector_colors,
    col = col_fun(plot_links$correlation),
    annotationTrack = "grid",
    transparency = 0.1,
    preAllocateTracks = list(
      list(track.height = 0.05),  # sector label track
      list(track.height = 0.03)   # outer ring track
    ),
    order = ordered_samples
  )

  # Track 1: Sample labels
  circos.trackPlotRegion(track.index = 1, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    tryCatch({
      circos.text(
        CELL_META$xcenter, CELL_META$ylim[1] + mm_y(1),
        CELL_META$sector.index,
        facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE,
        adj = c(0, 0.5), cex = 0.6
      )
    }, error = function(e) {})
  }, bg.border = NA)

  # Track 2: Cell type color ring
  circos.trackPlotRegion(track.index = 2, bg.col = celltype_ring_colors,
                         panel.fun = function(x, y) {}, bg.border = NA)

  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ## 7. Add legends
  ## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  draw(Legend(
    at = c(-0.6, 0, 0.6),
    col_fun = col_fun,
    title = "Pearson r",
    direction = "horizontal",
    legend_width = unit(3, "cm")
  ), x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(0.02, "npc"), just = c("center", "bottom"))

  draw(Legend(
    labels = names(celltype_colors),
    legend_gp = gpar(fill = celltype_colors),
    title = "Cell Type",
    ncol = 1
  ), x = unit(1, "npc"), y = unit(0.02, "npc"), just = c("right", "bottom"))

  dev.off()
}

## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 4.   Call circos function 
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
in_dir <- out_dir_d50_nMOST_nDIAcorrelationS_OrganelleComp

for (ann in selected_annotations) {
  message("Plotting circos for: ", ann)

  cor_path <- file.path(in_dir, paste0("cor_", ann, ".csv"))

  }

  cor_mat <- read.csv(cor_path, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)

    out_dir_d50_nMOST_nDIAcorrelationS_Circos,
    paste0("circos_", ann, ".pdf")
  )

  plot_annotation_circos(
    cor_mat = cor_mat,
    annot_name = ann,
    output_path = circos_out
  )
}


## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 5.   Function to calculate correlation for select annotation 
##      plots in pheatmap and saves as csv
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
calculate_annotation_correlation_matrix <- function(annot_name, neuron_df, hela_df) {
  # Filter for genes in annotation
  genes <- neuron_df %>%
    filter(!!sym(annot_name) == TRUE) %>%
    pull(Genes) %>%
    intersect(hela_df$Genes)

  # Prepare matrices
  neuron_mat <- neuron_df %>%
    filter(Genes %in% genes) %>%
    select(Genes, matches("^.*log2_fold_change.*")) %>%
    group_by(Genes) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    column_to_rownames("Genes")

  hela_mat <- hela_df %>%
    filter(Genes %in% genes) %>%
    select(Genes, matches("\\.KO$")) %>%
    group_by(Genes) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    column_to_rownames("Genes")

  # Keep only common genes
  common_genes <- intersect(rownames(neuron_mat), rownames(hela_mat))
  if (length(common_genes) < 5) {
    warning(paste("Too few genes for", annot_name))
    return(NULL)
  }

  neuron_mat <- neuron_mat[common_genes, ]
  hela_mat <- hela_mat[common_genes, ]

  # Pearson correlation
  cor_mat <- cor(neuron_mat, hela_mat, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

  # Save CSV
  write.csv(
    cor_mat,
    file = file.path(out_dir_d50_nMOST_nDIAcorrelationS_OrganelleComp, paste0("cor_", annot_name, ".csv")),
    quote = FALSE
  )

  # Prepare annotation for heatmap rows
  celltype_vec <- ifelse(grepl("iN", rownames(cor_mat)), "iN",
                         ifelse(grepl("iDA", rownames(cor_mat)), "iDA", NA))
  annotation_row <- data.frame(CellType = factor(celltype_vec, levels = c("iN", "iDA")))
  rownames(annotation_row) <- rownames(cor_mat)
  annotation_colors <- list(CellType = c(iN = "grey40", iDA = "grey80"))

  # Plot heatmap
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    cor_mat,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    main = paste("Correlation:", annot_name),
    annotation_row = annotation_row,
    annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
    color = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu")),
    fontsize = 6,
    border_color = NA,
    cellheight = 8,
    cellwidth = 8,
    filename = file.path(out_dir_d50_nMOST_nDIAcorrelationS_OrganelleComp, paste0("cor_", annot_name, ".pdf")),
    width = 8,
    height = 8
  )

  return(cor_mat)
}


## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
## 6.   Call function and plot heatmaps + csv files   
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_corrs <- lapply(selected_annotations, function(ann) {
  message("Processing: ", ann)
  calculate_annotation_correlation_matrix(ann, complete_data_annotated_day50, HeLaWCnMOST_df_annotated)
})
```

# XVIII. PPI vulnerability pipeline in iN and iDA LSD mutants
Build a Protein–Protein Interaction (PPI) vulnerability and rewiring landscape for neuronal proteomes (iN and iDA) across 23 lysosomal KOs. The goal is to integrate experimental proteome shifts with predicted and experimentally validated interaction data (Predictome 80% and IntAct) to quantify network destabilization, organelle-specific vulnerabilities, and neuron-type–specific effects.

use of the Baker lab's Human interactome
https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.10.01.615885v1.full
and InterAct Database

### XVIIIa.PPI input and merging of evidence 
##### Load Human Interactome & parse 
```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 1.  Define Paths and input tables 
out_dir_ppi_vuln <- out_dir_PPI
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/global"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/by_ko"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

path_predictome80 <- "/Users/felix/Desktop/ppi/final_predictions_80.tsv"
path_intact_tsv    <- "/Users/felix/Desktop/ppi/interact.tsv"

drop_thresh      <- -0.5    # partner considered dropped if log2FC < drop_thresh
gain_up_thresh   <-  0.5    # optional: partner considered gained if log2FC > gain_up_thresh
conf_bins        <- c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1)
org_min_n        <- 20
top_n_links      <- 3000


# reformat disease class list to dataframe
disease_classes_dataframe <- stack(disease_classes)
colnames(disease_classes_dataframe) <- c("sample", "DiseaseClass")


# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 2: Make helper Functions 
# Purpose: create a unique, order-independent identifier for each protein pair.
.make_undirected_key <- function(a, b) {
  ifelse(a <= b, paste(a, b, sep = "::"), paste(b, a, sep = "::"))
}

# Purpose: convert a continuous confidence score (0–1) into discrete bins.
.bin_conf <- function(x, bins) {
  cut(x, breaks = bins, include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
}


# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 3. load Predictome80 dataframe into environment 
predictome_raw <- data.table::fread(
  path_predictome80,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  skip = 28, 
  fill = TRUE,          # tolerate irregular number of fields
  quote = "",           # ignore quoted entries
  data.table = FALSE
)

# remove metadata rows (those starting with '#')
predictome_raw <- predictome_raw[!grepl("^#", predictome_raw$Protein1), ]

# define probability columns dynamically
prob_candidates <- c("RFprob","AFprob","AFMprob","CFprob","AFprob5")
prob_cols <- intersect(prob_candidates, names(predictome_raw))

# compute composite confidence score
predictome_edges <- predictome_raw %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(prob_cols), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) %>%
  mutate(
    Predictome_conf = do.call(pmax, c(across(all_of(prob_cols)), list(na.rm = TRUE))),
    STRING = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(STRING)),
    key = .make_undirected_key(Protein1, Protein2),
    Predictome_present = TRUE
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Protein1, Protein2, Name1, Name2,
    across(all_of(prob_cols)),
    Predictome_conf,
    STRING,
    confDBs,
    allDBs,
    Source,
    PDBtemp,
    Known1, Known2,
    Count1, Count2,
    Locality1, Locality2,
    Disease1, Disease2,
    Process1, Process2,
    Function1, Function2,
    Exact_templates, Ortho_templates, Homo_templates,
    key,
    Predictome_present
  ) %>%
  distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE)

```


##### Load InterAct & parse 
use select experimental evidence and larger than 0.5 as threshold 
```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 4. Load IntAct (already filtered by your MI methods and MIscore >= 0.5 when exporting)
intact_edges <- intact_raw %>%
  transmute(
    Protein1 = sub("^uniprotkb:", "", sub("\\|.*$", "", `ID(s) interactor A`)),
    Protein2 = sub("^uniprotkb:", "", sub("\\|.*$", "", `ID(s) interactor B`)),
    DetectionMethod = gsub('psi-mi:|"', "", `Interaction detection method(s)`),
    IntAct_MIscore = {
      x <- `Confidence value(s)`
      x <- sub("^.*miscore:", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)    # drop 'intact-miscore:' prefix
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
    }
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    key = .make_undirected_key(Protein1, Protein2),
    IntAct_present = TRUE
  ) %>%
  distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE)

```


##### Merge PPIs and add subcell annotations
```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 5. Merge Predictome + IntAct into PPI_evidence dataframe
ppi_evidence <- full_join(
  predictome_edges %>% select(key, Protein1, Protein2, Name1, Name2, RFprob, AFprob, AFMprob, Predictome_conf, Predictome_present, STRING, confDBs, allDBs),
  intact_edges     %>% select(key, IntAct_present, IntAct_MIscore, DetectionMethod),
  by = "key"
) %>%
  mutate(
    Predictome_present = replace_na(Predictome_present, FALSE),
    IntAct_present     = replace_na(IntAct_present, FALSE),
    Overlap_flag       = Predictome_present & IntAct_present
  )

# save csv
write_csv(ppi_evidence,"/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/Proteomics/d50_diff132/day50/PPI/tables/ppi_evidence.csv")


# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 6. add subcellular annotations for each partner
# Build a UniProt -> Gene map from Predictome (Name1/Name2 are gene symbols)
map_uni_to_gene <- bind_rows(
  predictome_raw %>% transmute(uni = Protein1, gene = Name1),
  predictome_raw %>% transmute(uni = Protein2, gene = Name2)
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(uni), !is.na(gene), nzchar(uni), nzchar(gene)) %>%
  distinct(uni, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add gene symbols for each partner
ppi_evidence <- ppi_evidence %>%
  left_join(map_uni_to_gene, by = c("Protein1" = "uni")) %>% rename(Gene1 = gene) %>%
  left_join(map_uni_to_gene, by = c("Protein2" = "uni")) %>% rename(Gene2 = gene)

# Step 6.1. add subcellular annotations using Gene1/Gene2 (to match binary_matrix$Genes nomenclature in df)
# expects binary_matrix with columns: Genes and organelle flags
organelle_tags <- setdiff(colnames(binary_matrix), c("Genes", "NeuroDev"))
gene_to_org <- binary_matrix %>% select(Genes, all_of(organelle_tags))

ppi_evidence <- ppi_evidence %>%
  left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("Gene1" = "Genes")) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_prot1"), all_of(organelle_tags)) %>%
  left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("Gene2" = "Genes")) %>%
  rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_prot2"), all_of(organelle_tags))

# Step 6.2. filter to union neuronal proteome using gene symbols
neuronal_genes <- complete_data_annotated_day50 %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique()
ppi_evidence <- ppi_evidence %>%
  filter(Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes, Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes)

# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 7. Union baseline edges (unchanged, but Predictome_conf_bin simplified for robustness)
baseline_edges_union <- ppi_evidence %>%
  mutate(
    Predictome_conf_clamped = pmin(pmax(Predictome_conf, 0, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Predictome_conf_bin = cut(Predictome_conf_clamped, breaks = conf_bins, include.lowest = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  select(
    key, Protein1, Protein2, Gene1, Gene2, Name1, Name2,
    Predictome_present, IntAct_present, Overlap_flag,
    Predictome_conf, Predictome_conf_bin,
    STRING, confDBs, allDBs, IntAct_MIscore, DetectionMethod,
    everything()
  )

# save as csv
write_csv(baseline_edges_union, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "baseline_edges_union.csv"))


# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 8. Proteome long table (KO/neuron parsed robustly)
prot_long <- complete_data_annotated_day50 %>%
  pivot_longer(-Genes, names_to = "sample", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  filter(str_detect(sample, "log2_fold_change")) %>%
  mutate(
    genotype = sub("_.*$", "", sample),
    neuron = case_when(
      str_detect(sample, "_iDA_") ~ "iDA",
      str_detect(sample, "_iN_")  ~ "iN",
      TRUE                        ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(neuron))

# Ensure baseline has gene symbols for both partners
# Use Name1/Name2 from Predictome (gene symbols) as Gene1/Gene2
baseline_edges_union <- baseline_edges_union %>%
  mutate(
    Gene1 = if ("Gene1" %in% names(.)) Gene1 else Name1,
    Gene2 = if ("Gene2" %in% names(.)) Gene2 else Name2
  )

# Helper to compute same-organelle flags per row
.same_organelle <- function(df, organelle_tags) {
  prot1_mat <- as.data.frame(df[ paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1") ])
  prot2_mat <- as.data.frame(df[ paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2") ])
  # coerce to logical; NA -> FALSE for overlap test
  prot1_mat[] <- lapply(prot1_mat, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x)))
  prot2_mat[] <- lapply(prot2_mat, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x)))
  shared <- prot1_mat & prot2_mat
  ifelse(rowSums(shared) > 0, "same", "cross")
}
# explicit organelle column names in ppi_evidence/baseline_edges_union
org1_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")
org2_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")

# expand baseline to all KO × neuron contexts
ko_neuron_grid <- expand_grid(
  genotype = unique(prot_long$genotype),
  neuron   = unique(prot_long$neuron)
)

## Expand baseline_edges_union to every KO × neuron combination
baseline_expanded <- baseline_edges_union %>%
  mutate(dummy = 1) %>%
  left_join(
    ko_neuron_grid %>% mutate(dummy = 1),
    by = "dummy",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  select(-dummy)


# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 9. KO edge states (match by Gene1/Gene2 + genotype + neuron)
# add DiseaseClass mapping here for downstream plotting

# ensure one-to-one mapping for KOs
disease_map <- disease_classes_dataframe %>%
  dplyr::distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)

ko_edge_states <- baseline_expanded %>%
  dplyr::select(
    key, Protein1, Protein2, Gene1, Gene2,
    Predictome_conf, Predictome_conf_bin, IntAct_present, Overlap_flag,
    tidyselect::all_of(org1_cols),
    tidyselect::all_of(org2_cols),
    genotype, neuron
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, genotype, neuron, log2FC),
    by = c("Gene1" = "Genes", "genotype", "neuron")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(dA = log2FC) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, genotype, neuron, log2FC),
    by = c("Gene2" = "Genes", "genotype", "neuron")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(dB = log2FC) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    state = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(dA) & dA < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
      !is.na(dB) & dB < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
      (!is.na(dA) | !is.na(dB))     ~ "retained",
      TRUE                          ~ "unknown"
    ),
    OrgPair = .same_organelle(., organelle_tags),
    genotype_neuron = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype" = "sample")) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    key, Protein1, Protein2, Gene1, Gene2,
    genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron, DiseaseClass,
    dA, dB, state,
    Predictome_conf, Predictome_conf_bin, IntAct_present, Overlap_flag, OrgPair
  )

# save csv
write_csv(ko_edge_states, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "per_ko_edge_states.csv"))


# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- 10. Summary outputs for both knockout level and also on organelle annotation level 

# 10.1 On each KOxNeuronType level 
#total_baseline_edges = total number of PPI edges considered in the baseline network for that genotype–neuron context.
#n_lost = number of those edges where either protein partner’s log2FC dropped below your drop_thresh.
#fraction_lost = n_lost / total_baseline_edges = the proportion of baseline interactions that were lost.

# per KO × neuron
ko_summary_global <- ko_edge_states %>%
  group_by(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron) %>%
  summarise(
    total_baseline_edges = n(),
    n_lost     = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_retained = sum(state == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unknown  = sum(state == "unknown", na.rm = TRUE),
    fraction_lost = n_lost / total_baseline_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# save as csv
write_csv(ko_summary_global, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "ko_summary_global.csv"))

# 10.1 On each OrganellexKOxNeuronType level 
# tag which organelle shared: pick first TRUE shared among organelle_tags

# per organelle × KO × neuron
ko_summary_by_organelle <- ko_edge_states %>%
  filter(OrgPair == "same") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(shared_organelle = {
    prot1_flags <- baseline_edges_union[match(key, baseline_edges_union$key), paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")]
    prot2_flags <- baseline_edges_union[match(key, baseline_edges_union$key), paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")]
    shared <- organelle_tags[which(as.logical(prot1_flags) & as.logical(prot2_flags))]
    if (length(shared) == 0) NA_character_ else shared[1]
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(shared_organelle)) %>%
  group_by(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron, shared_organelle) %>%
  summarise(
    n_edges = n(),
    n_lost  = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    fraction_lost = n_lost / n_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# save as csv
write_csv(ko_summary_by_organelle, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "ko_summary_by_organelle.csv"))

```


### XVIIIb. QC Vizualization of prediction mapping based on organelles and annotations
```{r}
# --------- PPI QC Scatterplots: Confidence score distributions by organelle ---------

# Step 1: Join baseline edges with organelle annotations
ppi_qc_df <- baseline_edges_union |>
  select(key, RFprob, AFprob, AFMprob, Predictome_conf) |>
  left_join(shared_long, by = "key") |>
  filter(!is.na(tag))  # keep only edges with organelle annotation

# Step 2: Generate color palette for all organelle tags
n_tags <- length(unique(ppi_qc_df$tag))
organelle_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(n_tags)
names(organelle_colors) <- sort(unique(ppi_qc_df$tag))

# Step 3: Plotting function for confidence score distributions
plot_confidence_distribution <- function(df, score_col, out_dir, org_colors) {
  
  # Remove NA values for the specific score
  df_plot <- df |>
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(score_col)))
  
  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) {
    message("No data for ", score_col, "; skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Plot 1: Density plot by organelle
  p_density <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = !!sym(score_col), fill = tag)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, name = "Organelle") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "distribution by organelle"),
      x = score_col,
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("density_", score_col, "_by_organelle.pdf")),p_density, width = 8, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Plot 2: Box plot by organelle
  p_box <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = reorder(tag, !!sym(score_col), median), 
                                 y = !!sym(score_col), fill = tag)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "by organelle (ordered by median)"),
      x = NULL,
      y = score_col
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("boxplot_", score_col, "_by_organelle.pdf")),p_box, width = 8, height = 4.5, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Plot 3: Histogram with facets by organelle
  p_hist <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = !!sym(score_col), fill = tag)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~tag, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "distribution per organelle"),
      x = score_col,
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("histogram_", score_col, "_faceted.pdf")), p_hist, width = 10, height = 8, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# Step 4: Apply to all prediction scores
for (score in c("RFprob", "AFprob", "AFMprob", "Predictome_conf")) {
  plot_confidence_distribution(
    ppi_qc_df, 
    score, 
    file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "qc"),
    organelle_colors
  )
}

# Step 5: Summary statistics table
qc_summary <- ppi_qc_df |>
  group_by(tag) |>
  summarise(
    n_edges = n(),
    RFprob_mean = mean(RFprob, na.rm = TRUE),
    RFprob_median = median(RFprob, na.rm = TRUE),
    AFprob_mean = mean(AFprob, na.rm = TRUE),
    AFprob_median = median(AFprob, na.rm = TRUE),
    AFMprob_mean = mean(AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE),
    AFMprob_median = median(AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE),
    Predictome_conf_mean = mean(Predictome_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
    Predictome_conf_median = median(Predictome_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n_edges))

# save csv
write_csv(qc_summary, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "qc", "confidence_scores_by_organelle.csv"))

# Step 6: Overall score correlation heatmap
score_cols <- c("RFprob", "AFprob", "AFMprob", "Predictome_conf")
cor_matrix <- ppi_qc_df |>
  select(all_of(score_cols)) |>
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")

pheatmap::pheatmap(

  border_color = "black",
  filename = file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "qc", "heatmap_score_correlations.pdf"),
  width = 5,
  height = 4
)

# Step 7: Edge count per organelle barplot
edge_counts <- ppi_qc_df |>
  dplyr::count(tag) |>
  dplyr::rename(n_edges = n) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_edges))

p_counts <- ggplot(edge_counts, aes(x = reorder(tag, n_edges), y = n_edges, fill = tag)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = organelle_colors, guide = "none") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of PPIs per organelle",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Edge count"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "qc", "barplot_edge_counts_by_organelle.pdf"),p_counts, width = 6, height = 6, device = cairo_pdf)


# --- QC: Bubble plot of AFMprob vs Predictome_conf ---
# Option 1: per-protein / key level
if (exists("ppi_evidence")) {
  message("Generating QC bubble plot: AFMprob vs Predictome_conf")

  p_qc_bubble_key <- ggplot(ppi_evidence, aes(x = Predictome_conf, y = AFMprob)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, shape = 21, color = "black", fill = "skyblue", size = 2, stroke = 0.1) +
    labs(
      title = "PPI confidence relationship AFM vs composite Predictome",

      y = "AFM probability"
    ) +

      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
    )

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "qc", "bubble_AFMprob_vs_PredictomeConf_perKey.pdf"),
         p_qc_bubble_key, width = 5, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# Option 2: Aggregated by annotation tag (using ppi_qc_df)
if (exists("ppi_qc_df")) {
  message("QC bubble plot (annotation-level): AFMprob vs Predictome_conf")

  qc_tag_summary <- ppi_qc_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      AFMprob_mean = mean(AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE),

      n_edges = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  p_qc_bubble_ann <- ggplot(qc_tag_summary,
    aes(x = Predictome_conf_mean, y = AFMprob_mean, size = n_edges, fill = tag)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0.15) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = tag),
      size = 2.3,
      max.overlaps = 50,
      seed = 42,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = organelle_colors, drop = FALSE, name = "Annotation") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8), name = "Edge count") +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "grey50", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.3) +
    labs(
      title = "PPI confidence relationship (by annotation)",
      x = "Predictome confidence by annotation",
      y = "AFM probability by annotation"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")
    )

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "qc", "bubble_AFMprob_vs_PredictomeConf_byAnnotation.pdf"),p_qc_bubble_ann, width = 7, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
}
```

### XVIIIc. Vizualiztion of PPI loss
##### Plotting function for correlation heatmaps and summary stacked bar for PPI impact
```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------
# Plotting: global bars, KO×KO correlations (iN/iDA + combined), per-KO organelle heatmaps
plot_ppi_vulnerability <- function(df_edges,
                                   df_states,
                                   out_dir,
                                   plot_set = c("global_bar","global_corr","global_corr_combined","organelle"),
                                   neuron = "both",
                                   disease_class_df = NULL,
                                   top_n_links = 3000,   # kept for API compatibility
                                   save = TRUE) {

  # General configurations
  neuron <- match.arg(neuron, c("iN","iDA","both"))
  neuron_levels <- if (neuron == "both") c("iN","iDA") else neuron
  neuron_palette <- c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80")

  # disease class palette (use existing global if present)
  disease_class_palette <- if (exists("disease_class_palette")) {
    get("disease_class_palette", inherits = TRUE)
  } else {
    c(
      Sphigolipidoses="#D53E4F",
      Mucopolysaccharidoses="#F46D43",
      Glycoproteinoses="#FDAE61",
      Neuronal.ceroid.lipofucinoses="#FEE08B",
      Integral.membrane.protein.disorders="#E6F598",
      PTM.defects="#ABDDA4",
      Lipid.storage.diseases="#66C2A5"
    )
  }

  # one-to-one KO→DiseaseClass map
  disease_map <- NULL
  if (!is.null(disease_class_df)) {
    disease_map <- disease_class_df %>%
      dplyr::select(sample, DiseaseClass) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }

  # helper: build annotation colors safely to avoid gpar fill errors
  .ann_colors_safe <- function(annotation_df) {
    cols <- colnames(annotation_df)
    ann <- list()
    if ("neuron" %in% cols) ann$neuron <- neuron_palette
    if ("DiseaseClass" %in% cols) {
      present <- unique(stats::na.omit(annotation_df$DiseaseClass))
      present <- intersect(names(disease_class_palette), present)
      if (length(present) > 0) ann$DiseaseClass <- disease_class_palette[present]
    }
    if (length(ann) == 0) NULL else ann
  }

  
  
  # ----- GLOBAL STACKED BARS (separate per neuron) -----
  if ("global_bar" %in% plot_set) {
    for (nt in neuron_levels) {
      ppi_vul_global <- df_states %>%
        dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(state = factor(state, levels = c("retained","lost","unknown")))
      if (!is.null(disease_map)) {
        ppi_vul_global <- ppi_vul_global %>%
          dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype" = "sample"))
      }
      ppi_vul_global_sum <- ppi_vul_global %>%
        dplyr::group_by(genotype, state) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
        dplyr::group_by(genotype) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
        dplyr::ungroup()

      bar_ppi_global <- ggplot(ppi_vul_global_sum, aes(x = genotype, y = n, fill = state)) +
        geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(retained = "grey80", lost = "#C51B7D", unknown = "grey50")) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "edges", title = paste("Edge outcomes per KO –", nt)) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
        theme(
          panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1))

      if (save) {
        ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", paste0("bars_edge_outcomes_", nt, ".pdf")), bar_ppi_global, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
      }
    }
  }


  # ----- GLOBAL iN vs iDA bubble plot of lost PPIs -----
  if ("global_scatter" %in% plot_set && all(c("iN", "iDA") %in% neuron_levels)) {
    ppi_vul_global <- df_states %>%
      dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(state = factor(state, levels = c("retained","lost","unknown")))
  
    if (!is.null(disease_map)) {
      ppi_vul_global <- ppi_vul_global %>%
        dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype" = "sample"))
    }
  
      loss_summary <- ppi_vul_global %>%
        dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          n_tot = dplyr::n(),
          n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
          frac_lost = ifelse(n_tot > 0, n_lost / n_tot, NA_real_),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(
          id_cols = genotype,
          names_from = neuron,
          values_from = frac_lost
        ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          ratio_in_ida = iN / iDA,
          ratio_in_ida = dplyr::case_when(
            is.na(ratio_in_ida) ~ NA_real_,
            ratio_in_ida > 3 ~ 3,          # cap high outliers
            ratio_in_ida < 1/3 ~ 1/3,      # cap low outliers
            TRUE ~ ratio_in_ida
          ),
          diff = abs(iDA - iN),
          color = dplyr::case_when(
            is.na(iDA) | is.na(iN) ~ "NA",
            diff <= 0.05 ~ "within_band",
            TRUE ~ "outside_band"
          ),
          color = factor(color, levels = c("within_band", "outside_band"))
        )
          
    print(loss_summary)
    color_map <- c(within_band = "grey60", outside_band = "#C51B7D")
  
    
     # Create polygon data for ±0.1 band around x = y
    band_df <- data.frame(
      x = c(-0.05, 0.4, 0.4, -0.05),
      y = c(-0.05 + 0.05, 0.4 + 0.05, 0.4 - 0.05, -0.05 - 0.05)
    )

    
    # Plot bubble plot
    p <- ggplot(loss_summary, aes(x = iN, y = iDA)) +
      geom_polygon(data = band_df, aes(x = x, y = y),
                   fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
      geom_point(aes(fill = color, size = ratio_in_ida), shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.6, alpha = 0.9) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = genotype), size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 50, seed = 42) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0.05, linetype = "solid", color = "grey80") +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = -0.05, linetype = "solid", color = "grey80") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, drop = FALSE, name = "Deviation") +
      scale_size_continuous(name = "iN/iDA ratio", range = c(2, 6)) +
      coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = c(0, 0.35), ylim = c(0, 0.35), clip = "on") +
      labs(x = "Fraction lost PPIs (iN)", y = "Fraction lost PPIs (iDA)", title = "Genotype-wise PPI loss comparison") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5)
      )
  
    if (save) {
      ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", "scatter_ppi_loss_iN_vs_iDA.pdf"), p, width = 5.5, height = 5.5, device = cairo_pdf)
    }
  }
  
  
  
  
  # ----- GLOBAL KO×KO CORRELATION HEATMAPS (iN, iDA separately) -----
  if ("global_corr" %in% plot_set) {
    make_corr_for_neuron <- function(nt) {
      lost_df <- df_states %>%
        dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
        dplyr::transmute(genotype, key, lost = as.integer(state == "lost"))
      if (nrow(lost_df) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

      lost_wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(lost_df, names_from = key, values_from = lost, values_fill = 0)
      lost_mat <- as.data.frame(lost_wide)
      rownames(lost_mat) <- lost_mat$genotype
      lost_mat$genotype <- NULL
      if (nrow(lost_mat) < 2 || ncol(lost_mat) < 2) return(invisible(NULL))

      rho <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(t(as.matrix(lost_mat)),
                                         method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))

      # annotations aligned to rho order
      annotation_df <- data.frame(genotype = rownames(rho), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      if (!is.null(disease_map)) {
        annotation_df <- annotation_df %>%
          dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("genotype" = "sample"))
      }
      rownames(annotation_df) <- annotation_df$genotype
      annotation_df$genotype <- NULL
      ann_colors <- .ann_colors_safe(annotation_df)

      # plot heatmap
      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        mat = rho,
        scale = "none",
        color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101),
        breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102),
        na_col = "grey90",
        clustering_distance_rows = as.dist(1 - rho),
        clustering_distance_cols = as.dist(1 - rho),
        clustering_method = "ward.D2",
        show_rownames = TRUE,
        show_colnames = TRUE,
        use_raster = FALSE,
        annotation_col = annotation_df,
        annotation_row = annotation_df,
        annotation_colors = ann_colors,
        angle_col = "90",
        main = paste0("KO × KO similarity of lost PPIs (", nt, ")"),
        fontsize = 6,
        border_color = NA,
        cellheight = 6,
        cellwidth = 6,
        filename = file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", paste0("heatmap_lost_corr_", nt, ".pdf")), width = 9, height = 7)
      invisible(TRUE)
    }
    make_corr_for_neuron("iN")
    make_corr_for_neuron("iDA")
  }

  

  # ----- GLOBAL KO×KO CORRELATION HEATMAP (combined iN+iDA; all-by-all Spearman across neuron types) -----
  if ("global_corr_combined" %in% plot_set) {
  
    # build shared PPI feature space (same columns for iN and iDA)
    lost_long <- df_states %>%
      dplyr::mutate(lost = as.integer(state == "lost")) %>%
      dplyr::select(genotype_neuron, genotype, neuron, key, lost)
  
    if (nrow(lost_long) > 0) {
      lost_wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
        lost_long,
        names_from  = key,   # shared PPI space
        values_from = lost,
        values_fill = 0
      )
  
      rn <- lost_wide$genotype_neuron
      X  <- as.matrix(lost_wide[, setdiff(colnames(lost_wide),
                                          c("genotype_neuron","genotype","neuron")), drop = FALSE])
      rownames(X) <- rn
  
      if (nrow(X) >= 2 && ncol(X) >= 2) {
  
        # compute Spearman across all iN/iDA combinations
        rho <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(t(X), method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  
        # build annotation table: neuron + DiseaseClass
        annotation_df <- as.data.frame(lost_wide[, c("genotype_neuron","genotype","neuron"), drop = FALSE])
        rownames(annotation_df) <- annotation_df$genotype_neuron
        annotation_df$genotype_neuron <- NULL
  
        dc_map <- ko_edge_states %>%
          dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron, DiseaseClass) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(genotype_neuron = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_")) %>%
          dplyr::select(genotype_neuron, DiseaseClass)
  
        annotation_df$DiseaseClass <- dc_map$DiseaseClass[match(rownames(annotation_df), dc_map$genotype_neuron)]
  
        # drop empty columns and align to rho
        keep_cols <- vapply(annotation_df, function(x) any(!is.na(x)), logical(1))
        annotation_df <- annotation_df[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
        annotation_df <- annotation_df[rownames(rho), , drop = FALSE]
  
        # color maps
        ann_colors <- list()
        if ("neuron" %in% colnames(annotation_df))
          ann_colors$neuron <- c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80")
        if ("DiseaseClass" %in% colnames(annotation_df)) {
          present <- intersect(unique(stats::na.omit(annotation_df$DiseaseClass)),
                               names(disease_class_palette))
          if (length(present) > 0)
            ann_colors$DiseaseClass <- disease_class_palette[present]
        }
        if (length(ann_colors) == 0) ann_colors <- NULL
  
        # plot heatmap
        pheatmap::pheatmap(
          mat = rho,
          scale = "none",
          color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101),
          breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102),
          na_col = "grey90",
          clustering_distance_rows = as.dist(1 - rho),
          clustering_distance_cols = as.dist(1 - rho),
          clustering_method = "ward.D2",
          show_rownames = TRUE,
          show_colnames = TRUE,
          use_raster = FALSE,
          annotation_col = annotation_df,
          annotation_row = annotation_df,
          annotation_colors = ann_colors,
          angle_col = "90",
          main = "KO × KO similarity of lost PPIs (combined iN + iDA)",
          fontsize = 6,
          cellheight = 6,
          cellwidth  = 6,
          border_color = NA,
          filename = file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", "heatmap_lost_corr_combined.pdf"),width = 8, height = 8)
      }
    }
  }
  
  
  # ----- PER-KO ORGANELLE HEATMAPS (rows=organelles; cols=iN,iDA; 0..1) -----
  if ("organelle" %in% plot_set) {
    org1_cols <- grep("_prot1$", names(df_edges), value = TRUE)
    org2_cols <- grep("_prot2$", names(df_edges), value = TRUE)
    if (length(org1_cols) == 0 || length(org2_cols) == 0) {
      message("No organelle flags (*_prot1/_prot2) found in df_edges; skipping organelle heatmaps.")
    } else {
      organelle_flags <- sub("_prot1$", "", org1_cols)

      # per-edge organelle membership (both partners TRUE)
      edges_org_flags <- df_edges %>%
        dplyr::select(key, dplyr::all_of(org1_cols), dplyr::all_of(org2_cols))
      m1 <- as.data.frame(edges_org_flags[, org1_cols, drop = FALSE])
      m2 <- as.data.frame(edges_org_flags[, org2_cols, drop = FALSE])
      m1[] <- lapply(m1, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x)))
      m2[] <- lapply(m2, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x)))
      shared_mat <- as.matrix(m1) & as.matrix(m2)

      shared_long <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(shared_mat)), function(i) {
        idx <- which(shared_mat[i, ])
        if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)
        data.frame(key = edges_org_flags$key[i],
                   organelle = organelle_flags[idx],
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      })
      shared_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(shared_long)

      # fraction lost per (KO, neuron, organelle)
      frac_by_ko_neuron_org <- df_states %>%
        dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same") %>%
        dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, state) %>%
        dplyr::inner_join(shared_long, by = "key") %>%
        dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, organelle) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          n_tot = dplyr::n(),
          n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
          fraction_lost = ifelse(n_tot > 0, n_lost / n_tot, NA_real_),
          .groups = "drop"
        )

      all_kos <- sort(unique(frac_by_ko_neuron_org$genotype))
      for (g in all_kos) {
        hm_df <- frac_by_ko_neuron_org %>%
          dplyr::filter(genotype == g) %>%
          dplyr::select(organelle, neuron, fraction_lost) %>%
          tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = neuron, values_from = fraction_lost)

        if (!"iN" %in% names(hm_df)) hm_df$iN <- NA_real_
        if (!"iDA" %in% names(hm_df)) hm_df$iDA <- NA_real_

        hm_df <- hm_df %>% dplyr::arrange(organelle)
        rownames_df <- hm_df$organelle
        hm_df$organelle <- NULL

        hm_mat <- as.matrix(hm_df)
        rownames(hm_mat) <- make.unique(rownames_df)
        hm_mat <- hm_mat[, c("iN","iDA"), drop = FALSE]
        if (nrow(hm_mat) == 0) next

        annotation_col <- data.frame(neuron = c("iN","iDA"))
        rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(hm_mat)

        pheatmap::pheatmap(
          mat = hm_mat,
          scale = "none",
          color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101),
          breaks = seq(0, 1, length.out = 102),
          na_col = "grey90",
          cluster_rows = TRUE,
          cluster_cols = FALSE,
          show_rownames = TRUE,
          show_colnames = TRUE,
          use_raster = FALSE,
          annotation_col = annotation_col,
          annotation_colors = list(neuron = neuron_palette),
          angle_col = "90",
          main = paste0("Fraction lost by organelle - ", g, " (iN vs iDA)"),
          fontsize = 6,
          cellwidth = 6,
          cellheight = 6,
          border_color = NA,
          filename = file.path(out_dir, "plots/by_ko", paste0("heatmap_organelle_fraction_lost_", g, ".pdf")), width = 6, height = 9)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

##### Plotting function for stacked bargraphs for organelle PPI impact
```{r}
# --- Prepare shared_long and correctly named disease_class_df ---
shared_long <- {
  org1_cols <- grep("_prot1$", names(baseline_edges_union), value = TRUE)
  org2_cols <- grep("_prot2$", names(baseline_edges_union), value = TRUE)
  stopifnot(length(org1_cols) == length(org2_cols), length(org1_cols) > 0)
  tags <- sub("_prot1$", "", org1_cols)

  m1 <- baseline_edges_union[, org1_cols] |> lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) |> as.data.frame()
  m2 <- baseline_edges_union[, org2_cols] |> lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) |> as.data.frame()
  shared_mat <- as.matrix(m1) & as.matrix(m2)

  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(shared_mat)), function(i) {
    idx <- which(shared_mat[i, ])
    if (!length(idx)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(key = baseline_edges_union$key[i], tag = tags[idx], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}

# Ensure correct naming
disease_class_df <- disease_classes_dataframe



# --- Stacked organelle bars (genotypes on x, organelle classes as fill) ---
plot_organelle_stacked_bars <- function(df_states,
                                        shared_long,
                                        annotation_classes_corrgeno,
                                        annotation_class_colors_corrgeno,
                                        out_dir) {
  if (is.null(shared_long) || nrow(shared_long) == 0) {
  message("No shared organelle tags found; skipping organelle stacked bars.")
  return(invisible(NULL))
}

  # Step 1. Tag -> class map
  tag_map <- lapply(names(annotation_classes_corrgeno), function(cls) {
    tags <- annotation_classes_corrgeno[[cls]]
    data.frame(tag = tags, class = cls, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }) |> dplyr::bind_rows()

  # Step 2. Map tags -> classes and summarize per genotype/neuron/class
  shared_class <- shared_long |>
    dplyr::inner_join(tag_map, by = "tag") |>
    dplyr::distinct(key, class)

  loss_by_class <- df_states |>
    dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same") |>
    dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, state) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(shared_class, by = "key") |>
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, class) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_tot   = dplyr::n(),
      n_lost  = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_lost = ifelse(n_tot > 0, n_lost / n_tot, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Step 3. Map tags -> classes and summarize per genotype/neuron/class
  shared_class <- shared_long |>
    dplyr::inner_join(tag_map, by = "tag") |>
    dplyr::distinct(key, class)

  loss_by_class <- df_states |>
    dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same") |>
    dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, state) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(shared_class, by = "key") |>
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, class) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_tot   = dplyr::n(),
      n_lost  = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_lost = ifelse(n_tot > 0, n_lost / n_tot, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Step 4. Plotting helper (one neuron per PDF; x = genotype; fill = organelle class)
  plot_one_neuron <- function(nt) {
    dd <- loss_by_class |> dplyr::filter(neuron == nt)
    if (nrow(dd) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

    # alphabetical ordering and plotting bars by annotation
      dd <- dd |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          genotype = factor(genotype, levels = sort(unique(genotype))),
          class    = factor(class, levels = names(annotation_class_colors_corrgeno))
        )

    # restrict palette to present classes
    present_classes <- levels(dd$class)
    class_cols <- annotation_class_colors_corrgeno[names(annotation_class_colors_corrgeno) %in% present_classes]
    class_cols <- class_cols[present_classes]  # ensure order matches factor levels

    # Plot 4.1 counts: stacked by organelle class
    p_counts <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = genotype, y = n_lost, fill = class)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7, position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols, drop = FALSE, name = "Organelle") +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Lost PPIs (count)", title = paste0("Lost PPIs by organelle (", nt, ")")) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
      )
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", paste0("bars_organelle_lost_counts_", nt, ".pdf")), p_counts, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)

    # Plot 4.2 fractions: composition across organelle classes per genotype
    p_frac <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = genotype, y = n_lost, fill = class)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7, position = "fill", color = "black", linewidth =  0.2) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols, drop = FALSE, name = "Organelle") +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of lost PPIs", title = paste0("Composition of lost PPIs by organelle (", nt, ")")) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
      )
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", paste0("bars_organelle_lost_fraction_", nt, ".pdf")), p_frac, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }

  plot_one_neuron("iN")
  plot_one_neuron("iDA")
  
  #return(shared_long)
  
}


# --- Faceted barplot and pie charts by disease class and organelle tag ---
plot_ppi_diseaseclass_impact <- function(df_states, shared_long, disease_class_df, out_dir, disease_class_palette) {

  # Step 1: Extract unique key-tag pairs from shared_long
  shared_tags <- shared_long |>
    dplyr::distinct(key, tag)

  # Step 2: Prepare disease_class_df with uppercase sample column
  disease_map <- disease_class_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample = toupper(sample)) |>
    dplyr::select(sample, DiseaseClass) |>
    dplyr::distinct()

  # Step 3: Merge shared tags and disease class info into df_states
  df_tagged <- df_states |>
    dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same") |>
    dplyr::mutate(KO = toupper(gsub("(_.*)$", "", genotype))) |>
    dplyr::left_join(shared_tags, by = "key") |>
    dplyr::left_join(disease_map, by = c("KO" = "sample"))

  # Step 4: Ensure at least one valid DiseaseClass column exists
  stopifnot(any(grepl("^DiseaseClass(\\.|$)", colnames(df_tagged))))

  # Step 5: Keep rows with both tag and DiseaseClass (from either suffix)
  df_tagged <- df_tagged |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), !is.na(DiseaseClass.x) | !is.na(DiseaseClass.y)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(DiseaseClass = dplyr::coalesce(DiseaseClass.x, DiseaseClass.y))

  # Step 6: Aggregated bar data (tag × disease class × neuron)
  tag_disease_loss <- df_tagged |>
    dplyr::group_by(neuron, DiseaseClass, tag) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(n > 0)

  
 # ---- plotting calls of data ---- 
  # Plot 1: faceted stacked barplot by tag
  p_bar <- ggplot(tag_disease_loss, aes(x = DiseaseClass, y = n, fill = DiseaseClass)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~tag, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = disease_class_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Lost PPIs", title = "Lost PPIs by organelle tag and disease class") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", "bars_organelle_tag_by_diseaseclass.pdf"), p_bar, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)

  
  # Plot 2: Normalized Bar Charts by organelle tag and disease class
  bar_norm_tag_df <- df_tagged |>
    dplyr::filter(state == "lost") |>
    dplyr::group_by(neuron, DiseaseClass, tag) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      df_tagged |> 
        dplyr::distinct(KO, DiseaseClass, tag, neuron) |> 
        dplyr::count(DiseaseClass, tag, neuron, name = "n_KOs"),
      by = c("DiseaseClass", "tag", "neuron")
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(n_norm = n_lost / n_KOs) |>
    dplyr::filter(n_KOs > 0)
  
  # Plot function: one faceted barplot per neuron
  plot_normed_bar_by_tag <- function(nt) {
    dd <- bar_norm_tag_df |> dplyr::filter(neuron == nt)
    if (nrow(dd) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
  
    p <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = DiseaseClass, y = n_norm, fill = DiseaseClass)) +
      geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      facet_wrap(~tag, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = disease_class_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Normalized PPI loss per KO by tag –", nt),
        x = NULL,
        y = "Lost PPIs per KO"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
      )
  
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", paste0("bars_organelle_tag_by_diseaseclass_perKO_", nt, ".pdf")),p, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
  
  plot_normed_bar_by_tag("iN")
  plot_normed_bar_by_tag("iDA")
  
  
  # Plot 3: Pie charts iN / iDA
  pie_df <- df_tagged |>
    dplyr::filter(state == "lost") |>
    dplyr::group_by(neuron, DiseaseClass) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

  plot_one_pie <- function(nt) {
    dd <- pie_df |> dplyr::filter(neuron == nt)
    if (nrow(dd) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

    dd$fraction <- dd$n / sum(dd$n)

    pie <- ggplot(dd, aes(x = "", y = fraction, fill = DiseaseClass)) +
      geom_col(width = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      coord_polar("y") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = disease_class_palette, drop = FALSE) +
      labs(title = paste("PPI loss composition –", nt), fill = "Disease class") +
      theme_void(base_size = 6)

    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", paste0("pie_ppi_loss_diseaseclass_", nt, ".pdf")),pie, width = 4.5, height = 4.5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }

  plot_one_pie("iN")
  plot_one_pie("iDA")
  
}
```

```{r}
### Per-KO PPI vulnerability profiles by confidence scores
# --------- Per-KO PPI loss profiles: confidence score distributions for lost vs retained edges ---------

# --- Step 1: Create output directory structure
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/per_ko_neuron"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


# --- Step 2: Join ko_edge_states with baseline edge properties + organelle tags
# Make sure we're selecting the right columns from baseline_edges_union
ko_ppi_profiles <- ko_edge_states |>
  dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron, state, genotype_neuron) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    baseline_edges_union |> 
      dplyr::select(key, RFprob, AFprob, AFMprob, Predictome_conf),
    by = "key"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(shared_long, by = "key") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag), state %in% c("lost", "retained")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    state = factor(state, levels = c("retained", "lost"))
  )

# Check if columns exist
print("Column names in ko_ppi_profiles:")
print(colnames(ko_ppi_profiles))

# Check for missing confidence scores
print("Summary of confidence scores:")
print(summary(ko_ppi_profiles[, c("RFprob", "AFprob", "AFMprob", "Predictome_conf")]))


# --- Step 3: Generate color palettes
n_tags <- length(unique(ko_ppi_profiles$tag))
organelle_colors <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(n_tags)
names(organelle_colors) <- sort(unique(ko_ppi_profiles$tag))

state_colors <- c(retained = "grey70", lost = "#C51B7D")


# --- Step 4: Plotting function per KO × neuron
plot_ko_neuron_profile <- function(df, geno, nt, score_col, out_dir, org_colors, state_cols) {
  
  # Check if score_col exists
  if (!score_col %in% colnames(df)) {
    message("Column ", score_col, " not found in data; skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  df_subset <- df |>
    dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == nt) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[score_col]]))  # Use .data[[]] for dynamic column reference
  
  if (nrow(df_subset) < 10) {
    message("Insufficient data for ", geno, " ", nt, " (", score_col, "); skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  ko_label <- paste0(geno, "_", nt)
  
  # Plot 1: Density by state (lost vs retained)
  p_density_state <- ggplot(df_subset, aes(x = .data[[score_col]], fill = state)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = state_cols, name = "Edge state") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "– lost vs retained"),
      subtitle = ko_label,
      x = score_col,
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(ko_label, "_density_", score_col, "_by_state.pdf")),p_density_state, width = 5, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Plot 2: Box plot by organelle, faceted by state
  p_box_org <- ggplot(df_subset, aes(x = reorder(tag, .data[[score_col]], median, na.rm = TRUE), 
                                      y = .data[[score_col]], fill = tag)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.3, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~state, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "by organelle"),
      subtitle = ko_label,
      x = NULL,
      y = score_col
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(ko_label, "_boxplot_", score_col, "_by_organelle.pdf")),p_box_org, width = 9, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Plot 3: Histogram faceted by organelle + state overlay
  p_hist_org <- ggplot(df_subset, aes(x = .data[[score_col]], fill = state)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 20, position = "identity", alpha = 0.6, color = "black", linewidth = 0.1) +
    facet_wrap(~tag, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = state_cols, name = "State") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "distribution per organelle"),
      subtitle = ko_label,
      x = score_col,
      y = "Count"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(ko_label, "_histogram_", score_col, "_faceted.pdf")),p_hist_org, width = 10, height = 7, device = cairo_pdf)
}


# --- Step 5: Loop over all KO × neuron combinations
ko_neuron_combos <- ko_ppi_profiles |>
  dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_combos))) {
  geno <- ko_neuron_combos$genotype[i]
  nt   <- ko_neuron_combos$neuron[i]
  
  message("Processing: ", geno, " - ", nt)
  
  for (score in c("RFprob", "AFprob", "AFMprob", "Predictome_conf")) {
    plot_ko_neuron_profile(
      df = ko_ppi_profiles,
      geno = geno,
      nt = nt,
      score_col = score,
      out_dir = file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/per_ko_neuron"),
      org_colors = organelle_colors,
      state_cols = state_colors
    )
  }
}

# --- Step 6: Summary table per KO × neuron × state
ko_neuron_score_summary <- ko_ppi_profiles |>

    n_edges = n(),

    AFprob_mean = mean(AFprob, na.rm = TRUE),
    AFprob_median = median(AFprob, na.rm = TRUE),
    AFMprob_mean = mean(AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE),
    AFMprob_median = median(AFMprob, na.rm = TRUE),
    Predictome_conf_mean = mean(Predictome_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
    Predictome_conf_median = median(Predictome_conf, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(genotype, neuron, state)

# save csv
write_csv(ko_neuron_score_summary,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "ko_neuron_confidence_by_state.csv"))
```

##### Per-KO × Neuron organelle-specific PPI state
```{r}
# --------- Stacked bars: lost vs retained PPIs per organelle for each KO × neuron ---------

# --- Step 1: Define plotting function for viz PPIs on organelle levels (KO x neurontype)
plot_ko_neuron_organelle_bars <- function(df, out_dir, org_colors) {
  
  # Prepare data: count lost/retained per KO × neuron × organelle
  organelle_state_counts <- df |>
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, tag, state) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::mutate(genotype_neuron = paste(genotype, neuron, sep = "_"))
  
  # Get unique KO × neuron combinations
  ko_neuron_combos <- organelle_state_counts |>
    dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron, genotype_neuron)
  
  # Plot for each KO × neuron
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(ko_neuron_combos))) {
    geno <- ko_neuron_combos$genotype[i]
    nt   <- ko_neuron_combos$neuron[i]
    ko_label <- ko_neuron_combos$genotype_neuron[i]
    
    df_subset <- organelle_state_counts |>
      dplyr::filter(genotype == geno, neuron == nt)
    
    if (nrow(df_subset) == 0) next
    
    # Plot 1: Stacked counts (absolute)
    p_counts <- ggplot(df_subset, aes(x = reorder(tag, -n, sum), y = n, fill = state)) +
      geom_col(position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(retained = "grey70", lost = "#C51B7D"),
        name = "State"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("PPI state per organelle –", ko_label),
        x = NULL,
        y = "Number of PPIs"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top"
      )
    
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(ko_label, "_bars_organelle_state_counts.pdf")),p_counts, width = 5, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
    
    # Plot 2: Stacked fractions (proportions)
    p_fractions <- ggplot(df_subset, aes(x = reorder(tag, -n, sum), y = n, fill = state)) +
      geom_col(position = "fill", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(retained = "grey70", lost = "#C51B7D"),
        name = "State"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("PPI state composition per organelle –", ko_label),
        x = NULL,
        y = "Fraction of PPIs"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top"
      )
    
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(ko_label, "_bars_organelle_state_fractions.pdf")),p_fractions, width = 5, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
  
  # Summary table: counts per KO × neuron × organelle × state
  summary_table <- organelle_state_counts |>
    dplyr::arrange(genotype, neuron, tag, state)
  
  write_csv(summary_table,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "ko_neuron_organelle_state_counts.csv"))
  
  invisible(summary_table)
}

  out_dir = file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/per_ko_neuron"),

)



# --------- iN vs iDA bubble plots per KO ---------
# --- Step 3: Bubble plot of iN vs iDA effect on PPIs loss per organelle annotation
plot_ko_bubble_in_vs_ida <- function(df, out_dir, org_colors) {
  
  # --- Step 3.1: Count lost PPIs per KO × neuron × organelle
  organelle_counts <- df |>
    dplyr::filter(state == "lost") |>
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, tag) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_lost = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # --- Step 3.2: Count total PPIs per KO × neuron × organelle (for normalization)
  totals <- df |>
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, tag) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n_total = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # --- Step 3.3: Merge totals and compute fraction lost
  organelle_counts <- organelle_counts |>
    dplyr::left_join(totals, by = c("genotype", "neuron", "tag")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(frac_lost = ifelse(n_total > 0, n_lost / n_total, NA_real_)) |>
    dplyr::filter(tag != "Nucleus")   # optional filter
  
  # --- Step 3.4: Pivot to wide format (iN vs iDA)
  organelle_wide <- organelle_counts |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = neuron,
      values_from = c(n_lost, frac_lost),
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  # --- Step 3.5: Loop over each KO
  all_kos <- unique(organelle_wide$genotype)
  
  for (geno in all_kos) {
    
    df_ko <- organelle_wide |>
      dplyr::filter(genotype == geno)
    
    if (nrow(df_ko) == 0) next
    
    # ABSOLUTE plot: iN_lost vs iDA_lost
    df_abs <- df_ko |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        total_lost = n_lost_iN + n_lost_iDA
      )
    
    max_val_abs <- max(c(df_abs$n_lost_iN, df_abs$n_lost_iDA), na.rm = TRUE)
    axis_lim_abs <- c(0, max_val_abs * 1.1)
    
    p_abs <- ggplot(df_abs, aes(x = n_lost_iN, y = n_lost_iDA, fill = tag, size = total_lost)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.2) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = tag), size = 2, max.overlaps = 30, seed = 42) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, name = "Organelle") +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), guide = "none") +
      coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = axis_lim_abs, ylim = axis_lim_abs, clip = "on") +
      labs(
        title = paste0(geno, " – Lost PPIs (absolute)"),
        x = "Lost PPIs in iN",
        y = "Lost PPIs in iDA"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
            legend.position = "right",
            legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))
    
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(geno, "_bubble_absolute_iN_vs_iDA.pdf")),p_abs, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
    
    
    # RELATIVE plot: normalized by total PPIs per neuron: (iDA_lost / total_iDA) ÷ (iN_lost / total_iN)
    df_rel <- df_ko |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        total_lost = n_lost_iN + n_lost_iDA
      )
    
    max_val_rel <- max(c(df_rel$frac_lost_iN, df_rel$frac_lost_iDA), na.rm = TRUE)
    axis_lim_rel <- c(0, max_val_rel * 1.1)
    
    p_rel <- ggplot(df_rel, aes(x = frac_lost_iN, y = frac_lost_iDA, fill = tag, size = total_lost)) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_point(shape = 21, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.2) +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(aes(label = tag), size = 2, max.overlaps = 30, seed = 42) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, name = "Organelle") +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10), guide = "none") +
      coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = axis_lim_rel, ylim = axis_lim_rel, clip = "on") +
      labs(
        title = paste0(geno, " – Lost PPIs (relative to total)"),
        x = "Fraction lost in iN",
        y = "Fraction lost in iDA"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
            legend.position = "right",
            legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"))
    
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(geno, "_bubble_relative_iN_vs_iDA.pdf")),p_rel, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
}

  df = ko_ppi_profiles,
  out_dir = file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/per_ko_neuron"),
  org_colors = organelle_colors
)
```

##### Sankey plot of lost PPIs per KO x neuron compared to baseline 
```{r}
# --------- Sankey plot: Lost PPIs per genotype (one plot per KO) ---------

# --- Step 1: Create Sankey plot for a single genotype ---
plot_ppi_loss_sankey_per_genotype <- function(df_states, shared_long, genotype_name, 
                                               out_dir, min_ppis = 10, save = TRUE) {
  
  # Filter to specific genotype and lost PPIs
  lost_ppis <- df_states |>
    dplyr::filter(state == "lost", genotype == genotype_name) |>
    dplyr::select(key, neuron) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(shared_long, by = "key") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag))
  
  if (nrow(lost_ppis) == 0) {
    message("No lost PPIs found for ", genotype_name)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Count total lost PPIs per organelle for this genotype
  organelle_counts <- lost_ppis |>
    dplyr::count(tag, name = "total_lost") |>
    dplyr::arrange(desc(total_lost))
  
  message("\n", genotype_name, " - Lost PPIs per organelle:")
  print(organelle_counts)
  
  # Keep major organelles only (adjusted threshold per genotype)
  major_organelles <- organelle_counts |>
    dplyr::filter(total_lost >= min_ppis) |>
    dplyr::pull(tag)
  
  if (length(major_organelles) == 0) {
    message("No organelles with ≥", min_ppis, " lost PPIs for ", genotype_name)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Aggregate minor organelles
  lost_ppis_clean <- lost_ppis |>
    dplyr::mutate(tag = ifelse(tag %in% major_organelles, tag, "Other"))
  
  # Create individual rows for EACH lost PPI
  flows_ida <- lost_ppis_clean |>
    dplyr::filter(neuron == "iDA") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      iDA = tag,
      Baseline = tag,
      iN = NA_character_
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(iDA, Baseline, iN)
  
  flows_in <- lost_ppis_clean |>
    dplyr::filter(neuron == "iN") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      iDA = NA_character_,
      Baseline = tag,
      iN = tag
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(iDA, Baseline, iN)
  
  # Combine - each row represents ONE lost PPI
  sankey_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(flows_ida, flows_in)
  
  # Convert to long format
  df_long <- sankey_data |>
    make_long(iDA, Baseline, iN)
  
  # Determine position and organelle for coloring
  df_long <- df_long |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      position = dplyr::case_when(
        x == "iDA" ~ "iDA",
        x == "Baseline" ~ "Baseline",
        x == "iN" ~ "iN",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      organelle = node
    )
  
  # Create color palette for organelles using RdYlBu
  unique_organelles <- unique(df_long$organelle[!is.na(df_long$organelle)])
  n_org <- length(unique_organelles)
  
  organelle_colors <- setNames(
    colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu")))(n_org),
    unique_organelles
  )
  
  # Create plot
  p <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = x, 
                           next_x = next_x, 
                           node = node, 
                           next_node = next_node, 
                           fill = organelle,
                           label = node)) +
    geom_sankey(
      flow.fill = "grey70",       
      flow.alpha = 0.4,           
      flow.color = NA,            
      space = 1,                  
      width = 0.2,                
      node.color = "black",       
      smooth = 8                  
    ) +
    geom_sankey_text(size = 2.5, color = "black", hjust = -0.1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = organelle_colors, na.value = "grey90") +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("iDA", "Baseline", "iN")) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Lost PPIs in", genotype_name, ": iDA ← Baseline → iN"),
      subtitle = paste("Organelles with ≥", min_ppis, "lost PPIs shown"),
      fill = "Organelle"
    ) +
    theme_sankey(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, face = "plain"),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "plain", size = 8),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 6, color = "grey40")
    )
  
  if (save) {
    # Clean genotype name for filename
    safe_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", genotype_name)
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/by_ko", paste0("sankey_ppi_loss_", safe_name, ".pdf")),p, width = 11, height = 8, device = cairo_pdf)
    message("Sankey plot saved for ", genotype_name)
  }
  
  return(p)
}


# --- Step 2: Loop through all genotypes ---
plot_all_genotype_sankeys <- function(df_states, shared_long, out_dir, 
                                      min_ppis = 10, save = TRUE) {
  
  # Get all unique genotypes
  all_genotypes <- unique(df_states$genotype)
  all_genotypes <- sort(all_genotypes)
  
  message("Creating Sankey plots for ", length(all_genotypes), " genotypes...")
  
  # Create plots for each genotype
  plot_list <- list()
  
  for (geno in all_genotypes) {
    p <- plot_ppi_loss_sankey_per_genotype(
      df_states = df_states,
      shared_long = shared_long,
      genotype_name = geno,
      out_dir = out_dir,
      min_ppis = min_ppis,
      save = save
    )
    
    if (!is.null(p)) {
      plot_list[[geno]] <- p
    }
  }
  
  message("\nCompleted ", length(plot_list), " Sankey plots!")
  
  return(invisible(plot_list))
}


# --- Step 3: Optional - Create summary table of PPI loss by genotype ---
summarize_ppi_loss_by_genotype <- function(df_states, shared_long, out_dir) {
  
  lost_ppis <- df_states |>
    dplyr::filter(state == "lost") |>
    dplyr::select(key, genotype, neuron) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(shared_long, by = "key") |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag))
  
  # Summary per genotype × neuron × organelle
  summary_table <- lost_ppis |>
    dplyr::count(genotype, neuron, tag, name = "n_lost") |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = neuron,
      values_from = n_lost,
      values_fill = 0
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      total = iDA + iN,
      iDA_fraction = iDA / total,
      iN_fraction = iN / total,
      diff = iN - iDA
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(genotype, desc(total))
  
  write_csv(
    summary_table,
    file.path(out_dir, "tables", "Sankey_ppi_loss_summary_by_genotype_organelle.csv")
  )
  
  message("Summary table saved!")
  
  return(summary_table)
}

  save = TRUE
)

)

print(head(genotype_summary, 20))
```
