### XVIIIe. GO functional enrichment of lost PPIs on a KO x neuron level
```{r}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# GO term enrichment on proteins involved in lost PPIs per KO × neuron
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# min of 5 lost PPIs per ontology
# focus on Biological process (BP)
# top_30 PPIs lost per KO x neuron

# --- Step 0: Create output directories ---
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/GO"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/GO"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Load required packages
# if (!requireNamespace("topGO", quietly = TRUE)) {
#   stop("Package 'topGO' is required. Install from Bioconductor:\n",
#        "BiocManager::install('topGO')")
# }
# if (!requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
#   stop("Package 'org.Hs.eg.db' is required. Install from Bioconductor:\n",
#        "BiocManager::install('org.Hs.eg.db')")
# }
# 
# library(topGO)
# library(org.Hs.eg.db)


# --- Step 1: Define GO enrichment function ---
run_GO_enrichment_for_lost_ppis <- function(gene_set, 
                                             background_genes, 
                                             tag = "KO_neuron", 
                                             out_dir,
                                             ontology = "BP",
                                             top_n = 30) {
  
  # Check if gene set is empty
  if (length(gene_set) < 3) {
    message("Insufficient genes (<3) for ", tag, "; skipping GO enrichment.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Step 1.1: Create geneList for topGO
  geneList <- factor(as.integer(background_genes %in% gene_set))
  names(geneList) <- background_genes
  
  message("  Running GO enrichment for ", tag, " (", length(gene_set), " genes)...")
  
  # Step 1.2: Run topGO Fisher test
  GOdata <- new("topGOdata",
                ontology = ontology,
                allGenes = geneList,
                geneSel = function(x) x == 1,
                annot = annFUN.org,
                mapping = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                ID = "symbol",
                nodeSize = 5)  # Minimum 5 genes per GO term
  
  resultFisher <- runTest(GOdata, algorithm = "elim", statistic = "fisher")
  
  # Step 1.3: Generate GO table
  go_table <- GenTable(GOdata, elimFisher = resultFisher, topNodes = top_n)
  
  # Handle cases where no significant terms found
  if (nrow(go_table) == 0) {
    message("  No significant GO terms found for ", tag)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  go_table <- go_table %>%
    mutate(
      raw_pval     = score(resultFisher)[GO.ID],
      Significant  = as.numeric(Significant),
      Expected     = as.numeric(Expected),
      Enrichment   = ifelse(Expected > 0, Significant / Expected, NA),
      log10P       = -log10(raw_pval),
      tag          = tag
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(raw_pval), !is.na(Enrichment)) %>%
    arrange(raw_pval) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)
  
  # Step 1.4: Get associated genes per GO term
  go_genes <- genesInTerm(GOdata)
  go_table$Genes <- sapply(go_table$GO.ID, function(go_id) {
    intersect(go_genes[[go_id]], gene_set) %>% paste(collapse = ";")
  })
  
  # Step 1.5: Save GO term table
  write_csv(go_table, file = file.path(out_dir, paste0("GO_results_", tag, ".csv")))
  
  # Step 1.6: Plot dot plot (only if we have results)
  if (nrow(go_table) > 0) {
    p <- ggplot(go_table, aes(x = Enrichment, y = reorder(Term, Enrichment))) +
      geom_point(aes(size = log10P, fill = Enrichment), 
                 shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.25) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "firebrick") +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 8)) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
      labs(
        x = "Fold Enrichment",
        y = "GO Term",
        size = expression(-log[10]*"P"),
        title = paste0("Top GO Terms: ", tag)
      ) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
      )
    
    # save pdf of GO dot plot per KO x neuron type
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("GO_dotplot_", tag, ".pdf")), p, width = 6, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
  
  return(go_table)
}


# --- Step 2: Extract proteins involved in lost PPIs per KO × neuron ---
# Get unique proteins from lost edges
proteins_in_lost_ppis <- ko_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(state == "lost") %>%
  dplyr::select(genotype, neuron, Gene1, Gene2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(Gene1, Gene2), names_to = "partner", values_to = "Gene") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Gene)) %>%
```

### XVIIIf. Multimer PPI Analysis
###### Trimer PPI complex analysis 
```{r}
# --------- Trimer identification and vulnerability analysis ---------
# --- Step 0: Create output directories ---
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/multimer"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Step 1: Filter to NEURONAL high-confidence PPIs only ---
conf_threshold <- 0.95

# Get neuronal genes (same as used in ko_edge_states)
neuronal_genes <- unique(c(ko_edge_states$Gene1, ko_edge_states$Gene2))
neuronal_genes <- neuronal_genes[!is.na(neuronal_genes)]

message("Number of neuronal genes: ", length(neuronal_genes))

# Filter high-confidence edges to neuronal proteome
high_conf_edges <- baseline_edges_union |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Predictome_conf >= conf_threshold,
    Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes,
    Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, Predictome_conf)

message("High-confidence neuronal edges (≥", conf_threshold, "): ", nrow(high_conf_edges))

# If too few, reduce threshold
if (nrow(high_conf_edges) < 100) {
  conf_threshold <- 0.90
  high_conf_edges <- baseline_edges_union |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Predictome_conf >= conf_threshold,
      Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes,
      Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, Predictome_conf)
  message("Reduced threshold to ", conf_threshold, ": ", nrow(high_conf_edges), " edges")
}

if (nrow(high_conf_edges) < 50) {
  conf_threshold <- 0.85
  high_conf_edges <- baseline_edges_union |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Predictome_conf >= conf_threshold,
      Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes,
      Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, Predictome_conf)
  message("Further reduced threshold to ", conf_threshold, ": ", nrow(high_conf_edges), " edges")
}

# Save high confidence dimers
write_csv(high_conf_edges, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables", "high_confidence_dimers.csv"))


# --- Step 2: Find all potential trimers (A-B, B-C, A-C all present) ---
# Create adjacency list
edges_df <- high_conf_edges |>
  dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2) |>
  dplyr::distinct()

message("Starting trimer search...")

# Find trimers: for each pair A-B, find all C where B-C and A-C both exist
trimers_list <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(edges_df))) {
  if (i %% 100 == 0) message("  Processed ", i, "/", nrow(edges_df), " edges...")
  
  A <- edges_df$Gene1[i]
  B <- edges_df$Gene2[i]
  
  # Find all C connected to B
  C_via_B <- edges_df |>
    dplyr::filter((Gene1 == B & Gene2 != A) | (Gene2 == B & Gene1 != A)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(C = ifelse(Gene1 == B, Gene2, Gene1)) |>
    dplyr::pull(C) |>
    unique()
  
  if (length(C_via_B) == 0) next
  
  # Check if A-C edge exists for each C
  for (C in C_via_B) {
    ac_exists <- any(
      (edges_df$Gene1 == A & edges_df$Gene2 == C) |
      (edges_df$Gene1 == C & edges_df$Gene2 == A)
    )
    
    if (ac_exists) {
      # Found a trimer! Sort genes to avoid duplicates
      trimer <- sort(c(A, B, C))
      trimer_id <- paste(trimer, collapse = "::")
      trimers_list[[trimer_id]] <- trimer
    }
  }
}

message("Trimer search complete!")

# Convert to dataframe
trimers_baseline <- tibble::tibble(
  trimer_id = names(trimers_list),
  GeneA = sapply(trimers_list, `[`, 1),
  GeneB = sapply(trimers_list, `[`, 2),
  GeneC = sapply(trimers_list, `[`, 3)
)

message("Total trimers found in neuronal baseline: ", nrow(trimers_baseline))

# Save baseline trimers
write_csv(trimers_baseline, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "baseline_trimers.csv"))


# --- Step 3: Add organelle annotations to trimers ---
gene_to_org <- binary_matrix |>
  dplyr::select(Genes, all_of(organelle_tags))

trimers_annotated <- trimers_baseline |>
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("GeneA" = "Genes")) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_A"), all_of(organelle_tags)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("GeneB" = "Genes")) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_B"), all_of(organelle_tags)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("GeneC" = "Genes")) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_C"), all_of(organelle_tags))

# Determine shared organelle(s) - all three proteins must be in same organelle
trimers_annotated <- trimers_annotated |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    shared_organelle = {
      org_A <- organelle_tags[which(c_across(paste0(organelle_tags, "_A")))]
      org_B <- organelle_tags[which(c_across(paste0(organelle_tags, "_B")))]
      org_C <- organelle_tags[which(c_across(paste0(organelle_tags, "_C")))]
      
      shared <- Reduce(intersect, list(org_A, org_B, org_C))
      if (length(shared) == 0) "Other" else paste(shared, collapse = ";")
    }
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Summary by organelle
trimer_org_summary <- trimers_annotated |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(shared_organelle, sep = ";") |>
  dplyr::count(shared_organelle, name = "n_trimers") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_trimers))

message("Trimers by organelle:")
print(trimer_org_summary)

write_csv(trimer_org_summary, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "baseline_trimers_by_organelle.csv"))



# --- Step 4: Assess trimer integrity per KO × neuron ---
# 4a. Build UniProt→Gene mapping from ko_edge_states
uniprot_to_gene <- ko_edge_states |>
  dplyr::select(Protein1, Gene1) |>
  dplyr::rename(Uniprot = Protein1, Gene = Gene1) |>
  dplyr::distinct() |>
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    ko_edge_states |>
      dplyr::select(Protein2, Gene2) |>
      dplyr::rename(Uniprot = Protein2, Gene = Gene2) |>
      dplyr::distinct()
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(Uniprot, Gene)

message("UniProt→Gene mapping entries: ", nrow(uniprot_to_gene))


# 4b. Convert ko_ppi_profiles (UniProt keys) to gene-based keys
ko_ppi_profiles_genes <- ko_ppi_profiles |>
  tidyr::separate(key, into = c("UniprotA", "UniprotB"), sep = "::", remove = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::left_join(uniprot_to_gene, by = c("UniprotA" = "Uniprot")) |>
  dplyr::rename(GeneA = Gene) |>
  dplyr::left_join(uniprot_to_gene, by = c("UniprotB" = "Uniprot")) |>
  dplyr::rename(GeneB = Gene) |>
  dplyr::mutate(key_gene = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneB)) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(key_gene))

message("Converted ko_ppi_profiles to gene-level edges: ", nrow(ko_ppi_profiles_genes))


# 4c. Prepare trimer edges
trimers_with_keys <- trimers_annotated |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(GeneA) & !is.na(GeneB) & !is.na(GeneC)) |>
  dplyr::filter(rowSums(is.na(dplyr::across(where(is.logical)))) < ncol(dplyr::across(where(is.logical)))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    key_AB = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneB),
    key_BC = .make_undirected_key(GeneB, GeneC),
    key_AC = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneC)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(key_AB) & !is.na(key_BC) & !is.na(key_AC))

message("Removed ", nrow(trimers_annotated) - nrow(trimers_with_keys), " trimers with missing edges.")


# 4d. Expand to all KO × neuron contexts
ko_neuron_combos <- ko_ppi_profiles_genes |>
  dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron)

trimers_expanded <- trimers_with_keys |>
  tidyr::crossing(ko_neuron_combos)

message("Joining edge states for trimers...")


# 4e. Join KO×neuron-level edge states (gene-based)
trimers_ko_states <- trimers_expanded |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    ko_ppi_profiles_genes |> dplyr::select(key_gene, genotype, neuron, state),
    by = c("key_AB" = "key_gene", "genotype", "neuron")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(state_AB = state) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    ko_ppi_profiles_genes |> dplyr::select(key_gene, genotype, neuron, state),
    by = c("key_BC" = "key_gene", "genotype", "neuron")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(state_BC = state) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    ko_ppi_profiles_genes |> dplyr::select(key_gene, genotype, neuron, state),
    by = c("key_AC" = "key_gene", "genotype", "neuron")
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(state_AC = state) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    state_AB = tidyr::replace_na(state_AB, "retained"),
    state_BC = tidyr::replace_na(state_BC, "retained"),
    state_AC = tidyr::replace_na(state_AC, "retained"),
    n_lost = (state_AB == "lost") + (state_BC == "lost") + (state_AC == "lost"),
    trimer_state = dplyr::case_when(
      n_lost >= 2 ~ "broken",
      n_lost == 1 ~ "partial",
      n_lost == 0 ~ "intact",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    )
  )

message("Edge states joined successfully!")


# Save detailed trimer states
write_csv(trimers_ko_states,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimers_ko_states.csv"))


# --- Step 5: Summary: broken trimers per KO × neuron ---
trimer_ko_summary <- trimers_ko_states |>
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_intact = sum(trimer_state == "intact", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_broken = sum(trimer_state == "broken", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_partial = sum(trimer_state == "partial", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_unknown = sum(trimer_state == "unknown", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_broken = n_broken / n_total,
    frac_partial = n_partial / n_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(frac_broken))

write_csv(trimer_ko_summary,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_ko_summary.csv"))

message("Trimer breakage summary:")
print(trimer_ko_summary)


# --- Step 5b: Affected trimers by organelle × KO × neuron ---
# Collapse to one row per trimer per KO×neuron
trimers_affected <- trimers_ko_states |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    trimer_affected = ifelse(n_lost >= 1, "affected", "intact")
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(genotype, neuron, trimer_id, shared_organelle, trimer_affected)

# Count affected vs intact trimers per organelle × KO × neuron
trimer_affected_org_ko <- trimers_affected |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(shared_organelle, sep = ";") |>
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, shared_organelle, trimer_affected) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_trimers = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = trimer_affected,
    values_from = n_trimers,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    total = affected + intact,
    frac_affected = affected / total
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(frac_affected))

write_csv(trimer_affected_org_ko,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_affected_by_organelle_ko.csv"))

# Summarize across all KOs
trimer_affected_by_org <- trimer_affected_org_ko |>
  dplyr::group_by(shared_organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_affected = sum(affected, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_total = sum(total, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_affected = n_affected / n_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(frac_affected))

write_csv(trimer_affected_by_org,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_affected_by_organelle_summary.csv"))

message("Affected trimers by organelle (top 20):")
print(head(trimer_affected_org_ko, 20))


# --- Step 6: Broken trimers by organelle × KO × neuron ---
# Broken trimers (2+ edges lost)
trimer_broken_org_ko <- trimers_ko_states |>
  dplyr::filter(trimer_state == "broken") |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(shared_organelle, sep = ";") |>
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, shared_organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_broken = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_broken))

write_csv(trimer_broken_org_ko, file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_broken_by_organelle_ko.csv"))

# Summary by organelle (across all KOs)
trimer_broken_by_org <- trimer_broken_org_ko |>
  dplyr::group_by(shared_organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_broken = sum(n_broken), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_broken))

write_csv(trimer_broken_by_org,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_broken_by_organelle_summary.csv"))

# Partial trimers (1 edge lost)
trimer_partial_org_ko <- trimers_ko_states |>
  dplyr::filter(trimer_state == "partial") |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(shared_organelle, sep = ";") |>
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, shared_organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_partial = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_partial))

write_csv(trimer_partial_org_ko,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_partial_by_organelle_ko.csv"))

# Summary by organelle (across all KOs)
trimer_partial_by_org <- trimer_partial_org_ko |>
  dplyr::group_by(shared_organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_partial = sum(n_partial), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_partial))

write_csv(
  trimer_partial_by_org,
  file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "trimer_partial_by_organelle_summary.csv")
)

message("Broken trimers by organelle (top 20):")
print(head(trimer_broken_org_ko, 20))


# --- Step 7: Visualization - barplot of broken trimers per KO ---
  # Step 7.1: EDGES: Visualization - barplot of broken trimers per KO ---
p_trimer_bar <- ggplot(trimer_ko_summary, aes(x = reorder(genotype, -frac_broken), y = n_broken, fill = neuron)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80"), name = "Neuron") +
  labs(
    title = "Broken trimers edges per KO",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of broken trimers edges"
  ) +

    panel.grid = element_blank(),

  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/multimer", "bars_broken_trimers_per_ko.pdf"),p_trimer_bar, width = 9, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)


  # Step 7b: TRIMERS: Visualization – affected trimers per KO ---
p_trimer_affected_bar <- ggplot(
  trimer_affected_org_ko |> dplyr::filter(shared_organelle != "Other"),
  aes(x = reorder(genotype, -frac_affected), y = affected, fill = neuron)

# --- Step 8: Heatmap - broken trimers by organelle × KO ---
  # Step 8: EDGES: Heatmap - broken trimers by organelle × KO ---
for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {

}
```

##### Multimer Analysis: Dense Subgraph Detection 
```{r}
# --------- Identify protein complexes via community detection ---------
# Find highly interconnected modules using:
# - Louvain community detection
# - Leiden algorithm  
# - MCL (Markov Clustering)
# - Finds real biological complexes, handles partial connectivity
# if 75% of edges lost ==> compelx disruped 
# if 25% of edges lost ==> complex affecetd 


# --- Step 0: Load required package ---
if (!requireNamespace("igraph", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Package 'igraph' is required. Install with: install.packages('igraph')")
}
library(igraph)

# --- Step 1: Build baseline network from high-confidence edges ---
message("Building baseline PPI network...")

# Use same high_conf_edges from trimer analysis
baseline_net <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
  d = high_conf_edges |> dplyr::select(Gene1, Gene2),
  directed = FALSE,
  vertices = data.frame(name = unique(c(high_conf_edges$Gene1, high_conf_edges$Gene2)))
)

# Add edge weights (confidence scores)
igraph::E(baseline_net)$weight <- high_conf_edges$Predictome_conf

message("Baseline network: ", vcount(baseline_net), " proteins, ", ecount(baseline_net), " edges")


# --- Step 2: Community detection using Louvain algorithm ---
message("Running Louvain community detection...")

louvain_communities <- igraph::cluster_louvain(
  baseline_net,
  weights = igraph::E(baseline_net)$weight
)

# Extract community assignments - convert to integer
protein_communities <- data.frame(
  Gene = igraph::V(baseline_net)$name,
  community_id = as.integer(igraph::membership(louvain_communities)),  # FIXED: convert to integer
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

message("Found ", max(protein_communities$community_id), " communities")


# --- Step 3: Filter to meaningful complexes (size 3-10) ---
community_sizes <- protein_communities |>
  dplyr::count(community_id, name = "size")

valid_communities <- community_sizes |>
  dplyr::filter(size >= 3, size <= 10) |>
  dplyr::pull(community_id)

message("Communities with 3-10 proteins: ", length(valid_communities))

complexes_baseline <- protein_communities |>
  dplyr::filter(community_id %in% valid_communities) |>
  dplyr::arrange(community_id, Gene)

complexes_baseline <- complexes_baseline %>%
  dplyr::mutate(community_id = sprintf("Complex_%04d", as.integer(community_id)))

# Create complex IDs
complexes_baseline <- complexes_baseline %>%
  dplyr::mutate(community_id = as.integer(gsub("Complex_", "", community_id)))

complexes_summary <- complexes_baseline %>%
  dplyr::group_by(community_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    complex_id = paste0("Complex_", sprintf("%04d", community_id[1])),
    n_proteins = n(),
    proteins = paste(Gene, collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_proteins))

# save csv
write_csv(complexes_summary,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "baseline_complexes.csv"))

message("Baseline complexes summary:")
print(head(complexes_summary, 20))


# --- Step 4: Annotate complexes with organelles ---
complexes_annotated <- complexes_baseline |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    protein_communities |> 
      dplyr::left_join(complexes_summary |> dplyr::select(community_id, complex_id), by = "community_id"),
    by = c("Gene", "community_id")
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(gene_to_org, by = c("Gene" = "Genes"))

# Determine dominant organelle per complex
complex_organelle <- complexes_annotated |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(organelle_tags),
    names_to = "organelle",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(present == TRUE | present == 1) |>
  dplyr::group_by(community_id, organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_proteins = n(), .groups = "drop_last") |>
  dplyr::slice_max(n_proteins, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(organelle = ifelse(is.na(organelle), "Other", organelle))

complexes_summary <- complexes_summary |>
  dplyr::left_join(complex_organelle |> dplyr::select(community_id, organelle), by = "community_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(organelle = tidyr::replace_na(organelle, "Other"))

# Count by organelle
complex_org_summary <- complexes_summary |>
  dplyr::count(organelle, name = "n_complexes") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_complexes))

# save csv
write_csv(complex_org_summary,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "baseline_complexes_by_organelle.csv"))

message("Complexes by organelle:")
print(complex_org_summary)


# --- Step 5: Assess complex integrity per KO × neuron ---
message("Assessing complex disruption per KO...")

# Get all edges within each complex
complex_edges_list <- list()

for (cid in valid_communities) {
  complex_genes <- complexes_baseline |>
    dplyr::filter(community_id == cid) |>
    dplyr::pull(Gene)
  
  # Get all edges between proteins in this complex
  complex_edges <- high_conf_edges |>
    dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% complex_genes, Gene2 %in% complex_genes) |>
    dplyr::mutate(community_id = cid)
  
  complex_edges_list[[as.character(cid)]] <- complex_edges
}

complex_edges_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(complex_edges_list)

# Add complex_id
complex_edges_df <- complex_edges_df |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    complexes_summary |> dplyr::select(community_id, complex_id),
    by = "community_id"
  )

message("Total edges in complexes: ", nrow(complex_edges_df))


# --- Step 6: Match complex edges to KO × neuron states ---
# Convert to gene-based keys
complex_edges_df <- complex_edges_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(key_gene = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2))

# Expand to all KO × neuron
complexes_expanded <- complex_edges_df |>
  dplyr::select(complex_id, community_id, key_gene) |>
  tidyr::crossing(ko_neuron_combos)

# Join edge states
complexes_ko_states <- complexes_expanded |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    ko_ppi_profiles_genes |> dplyr::select(key_gene, genotype, neuron, state),
    by = c("key_gene", "genotype", "neuron")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    state = tidyr::replace_na(state, "retained"),
    edge_lost = state == "lost"
  )

# Aggregate per complex × KO × neuron
complex_ko_summary <- complexes_ko_states |>
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id, genotype, neuron) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_edges_total = n(),
    n_edges_lost = sum(edge_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_edges_lost = n_edges_lost / n_edges_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    complexes_summary |> dplyr::select(complex_id, n_proteins, organelle),
    by = "complex_id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
      complex_state = case_when(
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted",   # ≥75% edges lost
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.25 ~ "partial",     # 25-75% lost
        TRUE                    ~ "intact"
      )
  )

# save csv
write_csv(complex_ko_summary,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "complexes_ko_states.csv"))


# --- Step 7: Summary statistics ---
# Per KO × neuron
complex_disruption_summary <- complex_ko_summary |>
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_complexes = n(),
    n_intact = sum(complex_state == "intact"),
    n_disrupted = sum(complex_state == "disrupted"),
    n_partial = sum(complex_state == "partial"),
    frac_disrupted = n_disrupted / n_complexes,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(frac_disrupted))

# save csv
write_csv(complex_disruption_summary,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "complex_disruption_summary.csv"))

message("Complex disruption summary:")
print(complex_disruption_summary)


# Per organelle × KO × neuron
complex_org_ko_summary <- complex_ko_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(complex_state == "disrupted", organelle != "Other") |>
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, neuron, organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_disrupted = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_disrupted))

write_csv(complex_org_ko_summary,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "complex_disrupted_by_organelle_ko.csv"))

# Summary by organelle
complex_org_disrupted <- complex_org_ko_summary |>
  dplyr::group_by(organelle) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n_disrupted = sum(n_disrupted), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_disrupted))

# save csv
write_csv(complex_org_disrupted,file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "tables/multimer", "complex_disrupted_by_organelle_summary.csv"))


# --- Step 8: Visualizations ---
# Barplot: disrupted complexes per KO
p_complex_bar <- ggplot(
  complex_disruption_summary,
  aes(x = reorder(genotype, -frac_disrupted), y = n_disrupted, fill = neuron)
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80"), name = "Neuron") +
  labs(
    title = "Disrupted protein complexes per KO",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of disrupted complexes"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
  )

# save plot
ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/multimer", "bars_disrupted_complexes_per_ko.pdf"),p_complex_bar, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)


# Heatmap: disrupted complexes by organelle × KO
for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  complex_org_wide <- complex_org_ko_summary |>
    dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = organelle,
      values_from = n_disrupted,
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  if (nrow(complex_org_wide) < 2 || ncol(complex_org_wide) < 3) {
    message("Insufficient data for complex heatmap (", nt, "); skipping.")
    next
  }
  
  complex_org_mat <- as.matrix(complex_org_wide[, -c(1:2)])
  rownames(complex_org_mat) <- complex_org_wide$genotype
  
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    complex_org_mat,
    scale = "none",
    color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    border_color = NA,
    fontsize = 6,
    cellwidth = 10,
    cellheight = 10,
    main = paste("Disrupted complexes by organelle –", nt),
    filename = file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/multimer",paste0("heatmap_disrupted_complexes_by_organelle_", nt, ".pdf")),
    width = 10,
    height = 8
  )
}


# --- Step 9: Network visualization of top disrupted complexes (optional) ---
# Visualize the 5 most disrupted complexes
top_disrupted <- complex_ko_summary |>
  dplyr::filter(complex_state == "disrupted") |>
  dplyr::count(complex_id, sort = TRUE) |>
  head(5) |>
  dplyr::pull(complex_id)

for (cid in top_disrupted) {
  # Get complex proteins
  complex_proteins <- complexes_baseline |>
    dplyr::inner_join(
      complexes_summary |> dplyr::select(community_id, complex_id),
      by = "community_id"
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(complex_id == cid) |>
    dplyr::pull(Gene)
  
  # Subgraph
  complex_subnet <- igraph::induced_subgraph(baseline_net, complex_proteins)
  
  # Plot & save
  pdf(file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "plots/multimer", paste0("network_", cid, ".pdf")),width = 6, height = 6)
  plot(
    complex_subnet,
    vertex.label = igraph::V(complex_subnet)$name,
    vertex.size = 20,
    vertex.color = "skyblue",
    vertex.label.cex = 0.7,
    edge.width = 2,
    main = paste("Complex:", cid)
  )
  dev.off()
}

message("Complex analysis complete!")
```

##### Prepare Protein Complexes for Structure Prediction AF3
```{r}
# =========================================================================
# Prepare Protein Complex Data for AlphaFold Structure Prediction
# Extract UniProt IDs, sequences, and assign colors based on edge loss
# =========================================================================

# --- Step 0: Setup ---
library(UniProt.ws)  # For fetching sequences
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

out_dir_structures <- file.path(out_dir_ppi_vuln, "structures")
dir.create(out_dir_structures, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Color palette for edge loss (0% = blue, 50% = white, 100% = red)
loss_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#2c7bb6", "white", "#d7191c"))(201)


# --- Step 1: Function to fetch sequences from UniProt ---
fetch_uniprot_sequences <- function(uniprot_ids) {
  
  # Remove duplicates and NAs
  uniprot_ids <- unique(uniprot_ids[!is.na(uniprot_ids)])
  
  message("Fetching sequences for ", length(uniprot_ids), " UniProt IDs...")
  
  sequences <- list()
  
  for (uid in uniprot_ids) {
    tryCatch({
      # UniProt REST API endpoint
      url <- paste0("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/", uid, ".fasta")
      
      response <- httr::GET(url)
      
      if (httr::status_code(response) == 200) {
        fasta_text <- httr::content(response, "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
        
        # Parse FASTA (skip header, concatenate sequence lines)
        lines <- strsplit(fasta_text, "\n")[[1]]
        seq_lines <- lines[!grepl("^>", lines)]
        sequence <- paste(seq_lines, collapse = "")
        
        sequences[[uid]] <- sequence
        
      } else {
        warning("Failed to fetch sequence for ", uid)
        sequences[[uid]] <- NA_character_
      }
      
      # Be respectful to API
      Sys.sleep(0.1)
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Error fetching ", uid, ": ", e$message)
      sequences[[uid]] <- NA_character_
    })
  }
  
  return(sequences)
}


# --- Step 2: Assign hex colors based on fraction of edges lost ---
assign_complex_colors <- function(complex_summary_df, loss_palette) {
  
  # Ensure frac_edges_lost is between 0 and 1
  complex_summary_df <- complex_summary_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      frac_edges_lost = pmin(pmax(frac_edges_lost, 0), 1),
      color_index = round(frac_edges_lost * 200) + 1,  # Map to 1-201
      hex_color = loss_palette[color_index]
    )
  
  return(complex_summary_df)
}





# --- Step 3: Generate structure input files per complex ---
# Remove old function and reload
rm(generate_structure_files)


generate_structure_files <- function(complex_id, 
                                     complex_proteins,
                                     protein_to_uniprot,
                                     sequences,
                                     hex_color,
                                     frac_edges_lost,  # <-- Make sure this is here
                                     out_dir) {
  
  # Create complex-specific directory
  complex_dir <- file.path(out_dir, complex_id)
  dir.create(complex_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  # Debug: check what we're working with
  message("    Mapping ", length(complex_proteins), " proteins to UniProt IDs...")
  
  # Map gene symbols to UniProt IDs using dplyr filter
  mapping_df <- protein_to_uniprot %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gene %in% complex_proteins)
  
  if (nrow(mapping_df) == 0) {
    warning("    No UniProt IDs found for complex ", complex_id)
    message("    Proteins requested: ", paste(head(complex_proteins, 5), collapse = ", "))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  message("    Found ", nrow(mapping_df), " UniProt mappings")
  
  uniprot_ids <- mapping_df$UniProt
  genes <- mapping_df$Gene
  
  
  # --- File 1: UniProt IDs and sequences ---
  seq_df <- data.frame(
    UniProt_ID = uniprot_ids,
    Gene_Symbol = genes,
    Sequence = sapply(uniprot_ids, function(uid) {
      if (uid %in% names(sequences)) sequences[[uid]] else NA_character_
    }),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Remove entries without sequences
  seq_df <- seq_df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(Sequence), nchar(Sequence) > 0)
  
  if (nrow(seq_df) == 0) {
    warning("    No sequences available for complex ", complex_id)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  message("    Got sequences for ", nrow(seq_df), " proteins")
  
  # write csv file of amino acid sequence
  write_csv(seq_df, file.path(complex_dir, paste0(complex_id, "_sequences.csv")))
  
  
  # --- File 2: FASTA format for AlphaFold2 input ---
  fasta_file <- file.path(complex_dir, paste0(complex_id, "_sequences.fasta"))
  fasta_conn <- file(fasta_file, "w")
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(seq_df))) {
    writeLines(paste0(">", seq_df$UniProt_ID[i], "|", seq_df$Gene_Symbol[i]), 
               fasta_conn)
    writeLines(seq_df$Sequence[i], fasta_conn)
  }
  
  close(fasta_conn)
  
  
  # --- File 3: AlphaFold3-compatible JSON ---
  af3_chains <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(seq_df)), function(i) {
    list(id = list(LETTERS[i]), sequence = seq_df$Sequence[i], type = "protein")
  })
  
  af3_json <- list(name = paste0(complex_id, "_complex"), modelSeeds = list(), sequences = af3_chains, dialect = "alphafoldserver", version = 1)
  af3_json_file <- file.path(complex_dir, paste0(complex_id, "_alphafold3.json"))
  write_json(af3_json, af3_json_file, pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  
  
  # --- File 4: Metadata JSON ---
  metadata <- list(
    complex_id = complex_id,
    n_proteins = nrow(seq_df),
    proteins = seq_df$Gene_Symbol,
    uniprot_ids = seq_df$UniProt_ID,
    hex_color = hex_color,
    fraction_lost = frac_edges_lost,
    fasta_file = basename(fasta_file),
    alphafold3_json = basename(af3_json_file)
  )
  
  # save metadate for structure
  write_json(metadata, file.path(complex_dir, paste0(complex_id, "_metadata.json")), pretty = TRUE, auto_unbox = TRUE)
  
  
  # --- File 5: ChimeraX color script ---
  chimerax_script <- c(
    paste0("# ChimeraX color script for ", complex_id),
    paste0("# Color: ", hex_color, " (fraction lost: ", round(frac_edges_lost, 3), ")"),
    "",
    "# Open your AlphaFold structure first, then run:",
    paste0("color ", hex_color, " #1"),
    "",
    "# To color by chain (if needed):",
    sapply(seq_along(seq_df$Gene_Symbol), function(i) {
      paste0("# Chain ", LETTERS[i], ": ", seq_df$Gene_Symbol[i])
    })
  )
  
  # save color code look up for ChimeraX 
  writeLines(chimerax_script, file.path(complex_dir, paste0(complex_id, "_chimerax_colors.cxc")))
  message("    Generated files for ", complex_id, " (", nrow(seq_df), " proteins)")
  return(seq_df)
}


# --- Step 4: Build UniProt mapping ---
# Use existing predictome mapping
protein_to_uniprot <- baseline_edges_union %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene1, Protein1) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Gene = Gene1, UniProt = Protein1) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(
    baseline_edges_union %>%
      dplyr::select(Gene2, Protein2) %>%
      dplyr::rename(Gene = Gene2, UniProt = Protein2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Gene), !is.na(UniProt)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

message("UniProt mapping: ", nrow(protein_to_uniprot), " genes")
message("Columns in protein_to_uniprot: ", paste(colnames(protein_to_uniprot), collapse = ", "))
message("Sample mapping:")
print(head(protein_to_uniprot, 3))


# --- Step 5: Process all complexes ---
if (!exists("complex_ko_summary")) {
  stop("complex_ko_summary not found. Run complex analysis first.")
}

# Select disrupted complexes (adjust criteria as needed)
target_complexes <- complex_ko_summary %>%
  dplyr::filter(complex_state == "disrupted") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(complex_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_frac_lost = mean(frac_edges_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_proteins = dplyr::first(n_proteins),
    organelle = dplyr::first(organelle),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(mean_frac_lost)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 20)  # Top 20 most disrupted

# Assign colors
target_complexes <- assign_complex_colors(
  target_complexes %>% dplyr::rename(frac_edges_lost = mean_frac_lost),
  loss_palette
)

message("\nProcessing ", nrow(target_complexes), " complexes...")

# Add community_id for joining with complexes_baseline
target_complexes <- target_complexes %>%
  dplyr::mutate(community_id = as.integer(gsub("Complex_", "", complex_id)))


# --- Step 6: Get all UniProt IDs needed ---
all_complex_proteins <- complexes_baseline %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    target_complexes %>% dplyr::select(community_id),
    by = "community_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Gene) %>%
  unique()

message("Total unique proteins across selected complexes: ", length(all_complex_proteins))

all_uniprot_ids <- protein_to_uniprot %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene %in% all_complex_proteins) %>%
  dplyr::pull(UniProt)

message("Total UniProt IDs to fetch: ", length(all_uniprot_ids))

# Fetch sequences
all_sequences <- fetch_uniprot_sequences(all_uniprot_ids)


# --- Step 7: Generate files for each complex ---
structure_results <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(target_complexes))) {
  
  cid <- target_complexes$complex_id[i]
  
  message("\n--- Processing complex ", i, "/", nrow(target_complexes), ": ", cid, " ---")
  
  # Get proteins in this complex
  complex_proteins <- complexes_baseline %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      complexes_summary %>% dplyr::select(community_id, complex_id),
      by = "community_id"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(complex_id == cid) %>%
    dplyr::pull(Gene)
  
  message("  Proteins in complex: ", paste(head(complex_proteins, 10), collapse = ", "))
  message("  Number of proteins: ", length(complex_proteins))
  
  result <- generate_structure_files(
    complex_id = cid,
    complex_proteins = complex_proteins,
    protein_to_uniprot = protein_to_uniprot,
    sequences = all_sequences,
    hex_color = target_complexes$hex_color[i],
    frac_edges_lost = target_complexes$frac_edges_lost[i],  # <-- ADD THIS LINE
    out_dir = out_dir_structures
  )
  
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    structure_results[[cid]] <- result
    message("  ✓ Successfully generated files")
  } else {
    message("  ✗ Failed to generate files")
  }
}


# --- Step 8: Create master summary ---
master_summary <- target_complexes %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    structure_dir = file.path(out_dir_structures, complex_id),
    fasta_file = file.path(structure_dir, paste0(complex_id, "_sequences.fasta")),
    sequences_available = complex_id %in% names(structure_results)
  )

write_csv(master_summary, 
          file.path(out_dir_structures, "master_complex_summary.csv"))


# --- Step 9: Create README ---
readme_text <- c(
```

### XVIIIg. Loss of PPIs timecourse evaluation ASAH1 d30,d50,d70 (with d70 baseline correction)
```{r}
# =========================================================================
# PPI Loss Analysis: ASAH1 Timecourse (d30, d50, d70)
# With day 70 baseline correction for batch effects
# =========================================================================

# --- Step 0: Setup output directories ---
out_dir_timecourse <- file.path(out_dir_PPI, "timecourseASAH1")
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Color palette
neuron_palette <- c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80")
day_palette <- c(d30 = "#4575b4", d50 = "#91bfdb", d70 = "#e0f3f8")


# --- Step 1: Prepare timecourse proteome data ---
# Build long format with day, neuron, gene, log2FC
prepare_timecourse_proteome <- function() {
  
  # Day 30
  d30_long <- complete_data_annotated_day30 %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, ASAH1_iN_log2_fold_change, ASAH1_iDA_log2_fold_change) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(ASAH1_iN_log2_fold_change, ASAH1_iDA_log2_fold_change),
      names_to = "sample",
      values_to = "log2FC"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      day = "d30",
      neuron = ifelse(grepl("_iN_", sample), "iN", "iDA")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, day, neuron, log2FC)
  
  # Day 50
  d50_long <- complete_data_annotated_day50 %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, ASAH1_iN_log2_fold_change, ASAH1_iDA_log2_fold_change) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(ASAH1_iN_log2_fold_change, ASAH1_iDA_log2_fold_change),
      names_to = "sample",
      values_to = "log2FC"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      day = "d50",
      neuron = ifelse(grepl("_iN_", sample), "iN", "iDA")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, day, neuron, log2FC)
  
  # Day 70
  d70_long <- diff132_d70_df_annotated %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, d70_iN_log2fc_ASAH1, d70_iDA_log2fc_ASAH1) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(d70_iN_log2fc_ASAH1, d70_iDA_log2fc_ASAH1),
      names_to = "sample",
      values_to = "log2FC"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      day = "d70",
      neuron = ifelse(grepl("_iN_", sample), "iN", "iDA")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, day, neuron, log2FC)
  
  # Combine
  timecourse_proteome <- dplyr::bind_rows(d30_long, d50_long, d70_long) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genes), Genes != "", !is.na(log2FC))
  
  return(timecourse_proteome)
}

# --- Step 2: Compute PPI edge states per day × neuron ---
# Now using different baselines for d70 vs d30/d50
compute_timecourse_edge_states <- function(baseline_edges, 
                                            baseline_edges_d70,
                                            prot_long, 
                                            drop_thresh = -0.5) {
  
  # Get neuronal genes per day
  neuronal_genes <- unique(prot_long$Genes)
  
  # For d30 and d50: use original baseline
  baseline_filtered_d30d50 <- baseline_edges %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes, Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes)
  
  # Expand to d30 and d50
  day_neuron_grid_d30d50 <- expand_grid(
    day = c("d30", "d50"),
    neuron = c("iN", "iDA")
  )
  
  baseline_expanded_d30d50 <- baseline_filtered_d30d50 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      day_neuron_grid_d30d50 %>% dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1),
      by = "dummy",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-dummy)
  
  # For d70: use d70-specific baseline
  day_neuron_grid_d70 <- expand_grid(
    day = "d70",
    neuron = c("iN", "iDA")
  )
  
  baseline_expanded_d70 <- baseline_edges_d70 %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      day_neuron_grid_d70 %>% dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1),
      by = "dummy",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-dummy)
  
  # Combine both baselines
  baseline_expanded <- dplyr::bind_rows(baseline_expanded_d30d50, baseline_expanded_d70)
  
  # Join proteome data for both partners
  edge_states <- baseline_expanded %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, day, neuron, log2FC),
      by = c("Gene1" = "Genes", "day", "neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(dA = log2FC) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, day, neuron, log2FC),
      by = c("Gene2" = "Genes", "day", "neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(dB = log2FC) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(dA) & dA < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
        !is.na(dB) & dB < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
        (!is.na(dA) | !is.na(dB))     ~ "retained",
        TRUE                          ~ "unknown"
      ),
      day_neuron = paste(day, neuron, sep = "_"),
      baseline_used = ifelse(day == "d70", "d70_specific", "original")
    )
  
  return(edge_states)
}

  prot_long = timecourse_prot_long,

)

# Convert timecourse edge states to gene-based keys
timecourse_edge_genes <- timecourse_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, day, neuron, state) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(key_gene = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2))

# Assess trimer states per day × neuron
assess_timecourse_trimers <- function(baseline_trimers, edge_states) {
  
  # Prepare trimer edges with keys
  trimers_with_keys <- baseline_trimers %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      key_AB = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneB),
      key_BC = .make_undirected_key(GeneB, GeneC),
      key_AC = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneC)
    )
  
  # Expand to all day × neuron
  day_neuron_combos <- edge_states %>%
    dplyr::distinct(day, neuron)
  
  trimers_expanded <- trimers_with_keys %>%
    tidyr::crossing(day_neuron_combos)
  
  # Join edge states
  trimers_states <- trimers_expanded %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, day, neuron, state),
      by = c("key_AB" = "key_gene", "day", "neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(state_AB = state) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, day, neuron, state),
      by = c("key_BC" = "key_gene", "day", "neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(state_BC = state) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, day, neuron, state),
      by = c("key_AC" = "key_gene", "day", "neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(state_AC = state) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state_AB = tidyr::replace_na(state_AB, "retained"),
      state_BC = tidyr::replace_na(state_BC, "retained"),
      state_AC = tidyr::replace_na(state_AC, "retained"),
      n_lost = (state_AB == "lost") + (state_BC == "lost") + (state_AC == "lost"),
      trimer_state = dplyr::case_when(
        n_lost >= 2 ~ "broken",
        n_lost == 1 ~ "partial",
        n_lost == 0 ~ "intact",
        TRUE ~ "unknown"
      )
    )
  
  return(trimers_states)
}

# --- Step 10: Complex/multimer analysis for timecourse ---
message("\n=== Complex analysis for timecourse ===")

if (!exists("complexes_summary")) {
  message("complexes_summary not found. Run complex detection section first.")
} else {
  
  # Get complex edges
  complex_edges_list <- list()
  
  for (cid in unique(complexes_summary$community_id)) {
    complex_genes <- complexes_baseline %>%
      dplyr::filter(community_id == cid) %>%
      dplyr::pull(Gene)
    
    complex_edges <- high_conf_edges %>%
      dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% complex_genes, Gene2 %in% complex_genes) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        community_id = cid,
        key_gene = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2)
      )
    
    complex_edges_list[[as.character(cid)]] <- complex_edges
  }
  
  complex_edges_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(complex_edges_list) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      complexes_summary %>% dplyr::select(community_id, complex_id),
      by = "community_id"
    )
  
  # Expand to all day × neuron
  day_neuron_combos <- timecourse_edge_genes %>%
    dplyr::distinct(day, neuron)
  
  complexes_expanded <- complex_edges_df %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, community_id, key_gene) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(day_neuron_combos)
  
  # Join edge states
  complexes_timecourse_states <- complexes_expanded %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      timecourse_edge_genes %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, day, neuron, state),
      by = c("key_gene", "day", "neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state = tidyr::replace_na(state, "retained"),
      edge_lost = state == "lost"
    )
  
  # Aggregate per complex × day × neuron
  complex_timecourse_summary <- complexes_timecourse_states %>%
    dplyr::group_by(complex_id, day, neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_edges_total = n(),
      n_edges_lost = sum(edge_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_edges_lost = n_edges_lost / n_edges_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      complexes_summary %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, n_proteins, organelle),
      by = "complex_id"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      complex_state = dplyr::case_when(
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted",
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.25 ~ "partial",
        TRUE ~ "intact"
      ),
      day = factor(day, levels = c("d30", "d50", "d70"))
    )
  
  # save csv
  write_csv(complex_timecourse_summary, file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables", "timecourse_complex_states.csv"))
  
  # Summary statistics
  complex_disruption_timecourse <- complex_timecourse_summary %>%
    dplyr::group_by(day, neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_complexes = n(),
      n_intact = sum(complex_state == "intact"),
      n_disrupted = sum(complex_state == "disrupted"),
      n_partial = sum(complex_state == "partial"),
      frac_disrupted = n_disrupted / n_complexes,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # save csv
  write_csv(complex_disruption_timecourse, file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables", "timecourse_complex_disruption_summary.csv"))
  
  # Barplot
  p_complex_bars <- ggplot(complex_disruption_timecourse, aes(x = day, y = n_disrupted, fill = neuron)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_disrupted), position = position_dodge(0.7),
              vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
    labs(
      title = "Disrupted complexes in ASAH1 over time",
      x = "Differentiation day",
      y = "Number of disrupted complexes"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "plots", "bars_disrupted_complexes_timecourse.pdf"), p_complex_bars, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Heatmap per neuron
  for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
    heatmap_data <- complex_disruption_timecourse %>%
      dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
      dplyr::select(day, n_disrupted, n_partial, n_intact) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(n_disrupted, n_partial, n_intact),
                         names_to = "state", values_to = "count") %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = day, values_from = count)
    
    heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_data[, -1])
    rownames(heatmap_mat) <- heatmap_data$state
    
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      heatmap_mat,
      scale = "none",
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100),
      cluster_rows = FALSE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      display_numbers = TRUE,
      number_format = "%.0f",
      fontsize_number = 6,
      border_color = NA,
      cellwidth = 18,
      cellheight = 18,
      main = paste("Complex states over time –", nt),
      filename = file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "plots",
                          paste0("heatmap_complex_states_", nt, ".pdf")),
      width = 4,
      height = 3
    )
  }
  
  
  # --- Step 11: Heatmaps by annotation for trimers and complexes ---
  message("\n=== Creating annotation heatmaps for trimers and complexes ===")
  
  # TRIMER heatmaps by annotation
  if (exists("timecourse_trimer_states")) {
    
    # Annotate trimers with organelle tags
    timecourse_trimer_annotated <- timecourse_trimer_states %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        key_AB = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneB),
        key_BC = .make_undirected_key(GeneB, GeneC),
        key_AC = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneC)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(shared_long, by = c("key_AB" = "key")) %>%
      dplyr::rename(tag_AB = tag) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(shared_long, by = c("key_BC" = "key")) %>%
      dplyr::rename(tag_BC = tag) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(shared_long, by = c("key_AC" = "key")) %>%
      dplyr::rename(tag_AC = tag) %>%
      # Assign trimer to annotation if any edge has that annotation
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = c(tag_AB, tag_BC, tag_AC),
        names_to = "edge_type",
        values_to = "tag"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag)) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(trimer_id, day, neuron, tag, trimer_state)
    
    # Count broken trimers per annotation × day × neuron
    trimer_by_annotation <- timecourse_trimer_annotated %>%
      dplyr::filter(trimer_state == "broken") %>%
      dplyr::group_by(day, neuron, tag) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(n_broken = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(day = factor(day, levels = c("d30", "d50", "d70")))
    
    write_csv(trimer_by_annotation, 
              file.path(out_dir_timecourse, "tables", "timecourse_broken_trimers_by_annotation.csv"))
    
    # Create heatmaps per neuron
    for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
      heatmap_data <- trimer_by_annotation %>%
        dplyr::filter(neuron == nt) %>%
        tidyr::pivot_wider(
          names_from = day,
          values_from = n_broken,
          values_fill = 0
        )
      
      if (nrow(heatmap_data) < 2) {
        message("Insufficient data for trimer annotation heatmap (", nt, "); skipping.")
        next
      }
      
      heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_data[, -c(1:2)])
      rownames(heatmap_mat) <- heatmap_data$tag
      
      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        heatmap_mat,

      )

  }
  
  # COMPLEX heatmaps by annotation
```

```{r}
# PPI Loss Analysis: Multi-genotype Timecourse (ASAH1, SMPD1, GBA1, GRN)

# --- Step 0: Setup output directories ---
out_dir_timecourse_multi <- file.path(out_dir_PPI, "timecourse_multi_genotype")

# Color palettes
neuron_palette <- c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80")
day_palette <- c(d30 = "#4575b4", d50 = "#91bfdb")
genotype_palette <- c(
  ASAH1 = "#D53E4F",
  SMPD1 = "#F46D43", 
  GBA1 = "#ABDDA4",
  GRN = "#66C2A5"
)


# --- Step 1: Extract timecourse data for all 4 genotypes ---
message("\n=== Extracting timecourse proteome data for 4 genotypes ===")

# Helper function: extract genotype × day × neuron block
.extract_genotype_log2_block <- function(df_wide, genotype, day_label, neuron_label) {
  stopifnot(neuron_label %in% c("iN", "iDA"))
  stopifnot(genotype %in% c("ASAH1", "SMPD1", "GBA1", "GRN"))
  
  log2_col <- paste0(genotype, "_", neuron_label, "_log2_fold_change")
  
  if (!log2_col %in% colnames(df_wide)) {
    message("Column ", log2_col, " not found in dataframe; skipping.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df_wide %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, log2FC = all_of(log2_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Genes), Genes != "", !is.na(log2FC)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Genotype = genotype,
      Day = paste0("d", day_label),
      Neuron = neuron_label
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genes, Genotype, Day, Neuron, log2FC)
}

# Extract all combinations
genotypes <- c("ASAH1", "SMPD1", "GBA1", "GRN")
days <- list(d30 = complete_data_annotated_day30, d50 = complete_data_annotated_day50)
neurons <- c("iN", "iDA")

timecourse_list <- list()

for (geno in genotypes) {
  for (day_name in names(days)) {
    day_num <- as.numeric(gsub("d", "", day_name))
    df_wide <- days[[day_name]]
    
    for (nt in neurons) {
      key <- paste(geno, day_name, nt, sep = "_")
      timecourse_list[[key]] <- .extract_genotype_log2_block(
        df_wide, geno, day_num, nt
      )
    }
  }
}

# Combine all
timecourse_multi_prot_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(timecourse_list) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(log2FC)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Day = factor(Day, levels = c("d30", "d50")),
    Genotype = factor(Genotype, levels = genotypes)
  )

# Save csv
write_csv(timecourse_multi_prot_long, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "timecourse_multi_proteome_long.csv"))

message("Extracted proteome data:")
print(table(timecourse_multi_prot_long$Genotype, timecourse_multi_prot_long$Day))


# --- Step 2: Compute PPI edge states per genotype × day × neuron ---
message("\n=== Computing PPI edge states for all genotypes ===")

compute_multi_timecourse_edge_states <- function(baseline_edges, 
                                                  prot_long, 
                                                  drop_thresh = -0.5) {
  
  # Get neuronal genes
  neuronal_genes <- unique(prot_long$Genes)
  
  # Filter baseline to neuronal proteome
  baseline_filtered <- baseline_edges %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gene1 %in% neuronal_genes, Gene2 %in% neuronal_genes)
  
  message("Baseline edges in neuronal proteome: ", nrow(baseline_filtered))
  
  # Expand to all genotype × day × neuron combinations
  geno_day_neuron_grid <- prot_long %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Genotype, Day, Neuron)
  
  baseline_expanded <- baseline_filtered %>%
    dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      geno_day_neuron_grid %>% dplyr::mutate(dummy = 1),
      by = "dummy",
      relationship = "many-to-many"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-dummy)
  
  # Join proteome data for both partners
  edge_states <- baseline_expanded %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, Genotype, Day, Neuron, log2FC),
      by = c("Gene1" = "Genes", "Genotype", "Day", "Neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(dA = log2FC) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, Genotype, Day, Neuron, log2FC),
      by = c("Gene2" = "Genes", "Genotype", "Day", "Neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(dB = log2FC) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state = dplyr::case_when(
        !is.na(dA) & dA < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
        !is.na(dB) & dB < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
        (!is.na(dA) | !is.na(dB))     ~ "retained",
        TRUE                          ~ "unknown"
      ),
      geno_day_neuron = paste(Genotype, Day, Neuron, sep = "_")
    )
  
  return(edge_states)
}

timecourse_multi_edge_states <- compute_multi_timecourse_edge_states(
  baseline_edges = baseline_edges_union,
  prot_long = timecourse_multi_prot_long,
  drop_thresh = -0.5
)

# Save csv
write_csv(timecourse_multi_edge_states, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "timecourse_multi_edge_states.csv"))

    n_retained = sum(state == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost = n_lost / total_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# save csv

# --- Step 8: Trimer analysis for multi-genotype timecourse ---
message("\n=== Trimer analysis for multi-genotype timecourse ===")

if (!exists("trimers_baseline")) {
  message("trimers_baseline not found. Skipping trimer analysis.")
} else {
  
  # Convert edge states to gene-based keys
  timecourse_multi_edge_genes <- timecourse_multi_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, Genotype, Day, Neuron, state) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(key_gene = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2))
  
  # Assess trimer states
  assess_multi_timecourse_trimers <- function(baseline_trimers, edge_states) {
    
    trimers_with_keys <- baseline_trimers %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        key_AB = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneB),
        key_BC = .make_undirected_key(GeneB, GeneC),
        key_AC = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneC)
      )
    
    # Expand to all genotype × day × neuron
    geno_day_neuron_combos <- edge_states %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Genotype, Day, Neuron)
    
    trimers_expanded <- trimers_with_keys %>%
      tidyr::crossing(geno_day_neuron_combos)
    
    # Join edge states
    trimers_states <- trimers_expanded %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, Genotype, Day, Neuron, state),
        by = c("key_AB" = "key_gene", "Genotype", "Day", "Neuron")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(state_AB = state) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, Genotype, Day, Neuron, state),
        by = c("key_BC" = "key_gene", "Genotype", "Day", "Neuron")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(state_BC = state) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, Genotype, Day, Neuron, state),
        by = c("key_AC" = "key_gene", "Genotype", "Day", "Neuron")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(state_AC = state) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        state_AB = tidyr::replace_na(state_AB, "retained"),
        state_BC = tidyr::replace_na(state_BC, "retained"),
        state_AC = tidyr::replace_na(state_AC, "retained"),
        n_lost = (state_AB == "lost") + (state_BC == "lost") + (state_AC == "lost"),
        trimer_state = dplyr::case_when(
          n_lost >= 2 ~ "broken",
          n_lost == 1 ~ "partial",
          n_lost == 0 ~ "intact",
          TRUE ~ "unknown"
        )
      )
    
    return(trimers_states)
  }
  
  timecourse_multi_trimer_states <- assess_multi_timecourse_trimers(
    baseline_trimers = trimers_baseline,
    edge_states = timecourse_multi_edge_genes
  )
  
  write_csv(
    timecourse_multi_trimer_states,
    file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "timecourse_multi_trimer_states.csv")
  )
  
  # Summary
  timecourse_multi_trimer_summary <- timecourse_multi_trimer_states %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Genotype, Day, Neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_intact = sum(trimer_state == "intact", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_broken = sum(trimer_state == "broken", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_partial = sum(trimer_state == "partial", na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_broken = n_broken / n_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  write_csv(
    timecourse_multi_trimer_summary,
    file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "timecourse_multi_trimer_summary.csv")
  )
  
  # Barplot
  p_trimer_bars <- ggplot(
    timecourse_multi_trimer_summary,
    aes(x = Day, y = n_broken, fill = Neuron)
  ) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = n_broken),
      position = position_dodge(0.7),
      vjust = -0.5,
      size = 2
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Genotype, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
    labs(
      title = "Broken trimers across genotypes (d30 vs d50)",
      x = "Differentiation day",
      y = "Number of broken trimers"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "bars_broken_trimers_all_genotypes.pdf"), p_trimer_bars, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Line plot comparison
  timecourse_multi_trimer_numeric <- timecourse_multi_trimer_summary %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Day_numeric = as.numeric(gsub("d", "", Day)))
  
  p_trimer_lines <- ggplot(
    timecourse_multi_trimer_numeric,
    aes(x = Day_numeric, y = n_broken, color = Genotype, linetype = Neuron,
        group = interaction(Genotype, Neuron))
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = genotype_palette, name = "Genotype") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(iN = "solid", iDA = "dashed"), name = "Neuron") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(30, 50), labels = c("d30", "d50")) +
    labs(
      title = "Trimer breakage trajectory across genotypes",
      x = "Differentiation day",
      y = "Number of broken trimers"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "lines_broken_trimers_genotype_comparison.pdf"), p_trimer_lines, width = 4, height = 3.5,    device = cairo_pdf)
}


# --- Step 9: Complex analysis for multi-genotype timecourse ---
message("\n=== Complex analysis for multi-genotype timecourse ===")

if (!exists("complexes_summary") || !exists("complex_edges_df")) {
  message("complexes_summary or complex_edges_df not found. Skipping complex analysis.")
} else {
  
  # Expand complexes to all genotype × day × neuron
  geno_day_neuron_combos <- timecourse_multi_edge_genes %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Genotype, Day, Neuron)
  
  complexes_expanded <- complex_edges_df %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, community_id, key_gene) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(geno_day_neuron_combos)
  
  # Join edge states
  complexes_multi_timecourse_states <- complexes_expanded %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      timecourse_multi_edge_genes %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, Genotype, Day, Neuron, state),
      by = c("key_gene", "Genotype", "Day", "Neuron")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state = tidyr::replace_na(state, "retained"),
      edge_lost = state == "lost"
    )
  
  # Aggregate per complex × genotype × day × neuron
  complex_multi_timecourse_summary <- complexes_multi_timecourse_states %>%
    dplyr::group_by(complex_id, Genotype, Day, Neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_edges_total = n(),
      n_edges_lost = sum(edge_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_edges_lost = n_edges_lost / n_edges_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      complexes_summary %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, n_proteins, organelle),
      by = "complex_id"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      complex_state = dplyr::case_when(
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted",
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.25 ~ "partial",
        TRUE ~ "intact"
      )
    )
  
  # save csv
  write_csv(complex_multi_timecourse_summary,file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "timecourse_multi_complex_states.csv"))
  
  
  # Summary statistics
  complex_disruption_multi_timecourse <- complex_multi_timecourse_summary %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Genotype, Day, Neuron) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_complexes = n(),
      n_intact = sum(complex_state == "intact"),
      n_disrupted = sum(complex_state == "disrupted"),
      n_partial = sum(complex_state == "partial"),
      frac_disrupted = n_disrupted / n_complexes,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  write_csv(
    complex_disruption_multi_timecourse,
    file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "timecourse_multi_complex_disruption_summary.csv")
  )
  
  # Barplot
  p_complex_bars <- ggplot(
    complex_disruption_multi_timecourse,
    aes(x = Day, y = n_disrupted, fill = Neuron)
  ) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = n_disrupted),
      position = position_dodge(0.7),
      vjust = -0.5,
      size = 2
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ Genotype, ncol = 4, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
    labs(
      title = "Disrupted complexes across genotypes (d30 vs d50)",
      x = "Differentiation day",
      y = "Number of disrupted complexes"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "bars_disrupted_complexes_all_genotypes.pdf"), p_complex_bars, width = 6, height = 5,    device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Line plot comparison
  complex_disruption_multi_numeric <- complex_disruption_multi_timecourse %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Day_numeric = as.numeric(gsub("d", "", Day)))
  
  p_complex_lines <- ggplot(
    complex_disruption_multi_numeric,
    aes(x = Day_numeric, y = n_disrupted, color = Genotype, linetype = Neuron,
        group = interaction(Genotype, Neuron))
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = genotype_palette, name = "Genotype") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(iN = "solid", iDA = "dashed"), name = "Neuron") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(30, 50), labels = c("d30", "d50")) +
    labs(
      title = "Complex disruption trajectory across genotypes",
      x = "Differentiation day",
      y = "Number of disrupted complexes"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "lines_disrupted_complexes_genotype_comparison.pdf"), p_complex_lines,width = 4,height = 3.5, device = cairo_pdf)
}


# --- Step 10: Per-genotype detailed plots ---
message("\n=== Creating per-genotype detailed plots ===")

for (geno in genotypes) {
  
  # Filter data
  geno_summary <- timecourse_multi_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(Genotype == geno)
  
  if (nrow(geno_summary) == 0) next
  
  # Per-genotype barplot
  p_geno_bar <- ggplot(geno_summary, aes(x = Day, y = n_lost, fill = Neuron)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = n_lost),
      position = position_dodge(0.7),
      vjust = -0.5,
      size = 2.5
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Lost PPIs in", geno, "(d30 vs d50)"),
      x = "Differentiation day",
      y = "Number of lost PPIs"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/by_genotype", paste0("bars_lost_ppis_", geno, ".pdf")), p_geno_bar, width = 4, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  
  
 # Per-genotype annotation heatmaps
  for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {

    heatmap_data <- timecourse_multi_by_annotation %>%
      # fix: ensure matching types before filtering
      dplyr::mutate(Genotype = as.character(Genotype)) %>%
      dplyr::filter(Genotype == geno, Neuron == nt) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        id_cols = tag, # Only keep 'tag' as the row identifier
        names_from = Day,
        values_from = n_lost,
        values_fill = 0
      )

    if (nrow(heatmap_data) < 2) {
      message("Insufficient data for ", geno, " ", nt, " annotation heatmap; skipping.")
      next
    }

    # convert to numeric (only d30, d50)
    heatmap_data <- heatmap_data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(across(-tag, ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(trimws(as.character(.))))))

    # create matrix
    heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_data[, -1])
    rownames(heatmap_mat) <- heatmap_data$tag

    # skip if all values are NA or non-finite
    if (all(is.na(heatmap_mat)) || !any(is.finite(heatmap_mat))) {
      message("No finite values for ", geno, " ", nt, " heatmap; skipping.")
      next
    }

    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      heatmap_mat,
      scale = "none",
      color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100),
      cluster_rows = TRUE,
      cluster_cols = FALSE,
      show_rownames = TRUE,
      show_colnames = TRUE,
      border_color = NA,
      fontsize = 6,
      cellwidth = 8,
      cellheight = 8,
      main = paste("Lost PPIs by annotation -", geno, nt),
      filename = file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/by_genotype", paste0("heatmap_lost_ppis_by_annotation_", geno, "_", nt, ".pdf")),
      width = 4,
      height = 8
    )
  }
}


# --- Step 11: Bubble plots - iDA vs iN for each genotype ---
message("\n=== Creating bubble plots (iDA vs iN) per genotype ===")

# Prepare bubble data
bubble_multi_data <- timecourse_multi_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(Genotype, Day, Neuron, n_lost, total_edges) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Neuron,

  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    frac_lost_iN = n_lost_iN / total_edges_iN,
    frac_lost_iDA = n_lost_iDA / total_edges_iDA,

  )

# save csv
write_csv(bubble_multi_data, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "bubble_plot_data_iDA_vs_iN.csv"))

# Faceted bubble plot (all genotypes)
p_bubble_facet <- ggplot(
  bubble_multi_data,

) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +

    title = "Lost PPIs: iDA vs iN (all genotypes)",

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),

  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "bubble_iDA_vs_iN_all_genotypes.pdf"), p_bubble_facet, width = 5, height = 3, device =cairo_pdf)



# --- Step 12: Delta analysis (d50 - d30) ---
message("\n=== Computing delta (d50 - d30) ===")

delta_analysis <- timecourse_multi_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(Genotype, Day, Neuron, n_lost) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Day,
    values_from = n_lost
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta = d50 - d30,
    abs_delta = abs(delta)
  )

# save csv
write_csv(delta_analysis, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "delta_d50_minus_d30.csv"))

# Barplot of delta
p_delta <- ggplot(
  delta_analysis,
  aes(x = reorder(Genotype, -abs_delta), y = delta, fill = Neuron)
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
  labs(
    title = "Change in lost PPIs (d50 - d30)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Δ Lost PPIs (d50 - d30)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "bars_delta_d50_minus_d30.pdf"), p_delta, width = 2.5, height = 3, device = cairo_pdf)


# --- Step 13: Annotation-specific delta analysis ---
delta_by_annotation <- timecourse_multi_by_annotation %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Day,
    values_from = n_lost,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta = d50 - d30
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Genotype, Neuron, desc(abs(delta)))

# save csv
write_csv(delta_by_annotation, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "delta_by_annotation.csv"))

# --- Heatmap of delta per annotation ---
for (nt in c("iN", "iDA")) {
  
  heatmap_delta <- delta_by_annotation %>%
    dplyr::filter(Neuron == nt) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = Genotype,
      values_from = delta,
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  if (nrow(heatmap_delta) < 2) {
    message("Insufficient data for delta heatmap (", nt, "); skipping.")
    next
  }

  # Remove raw count columns and duplicates
  heatmap_delta <- heatmap_delta %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(d30, d50)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(tag, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(across(-c(Neuron, tag), ~ as.numeric(.)))

  # Create numeric matrix with unique rownames
  heatmap_mat <- heatmap_delta %>%
    dplyr::select(-Neuron) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("tag") %>%
    as.matrix()

  # Center color scale at 0
  max_abs <- max(abs(heatmap_mat), na.rm = TRUE)

  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    heatmap_mat,
    scale = "none",
    color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101),
    breaks = seq(-max_abs, max_abs, length.out = 102),
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,
    border_color = NA,
    fontsize = 6,
    cellwidth = 8,
    cellheight = 8,
    main = paste("delta Lost PPIs by annotation (d50 - d30) -", nt),
    filename = file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", paste0("heatmap_delta_by_annotation_", nt, ".pdf")),
    width = 6,
    height = 10
  )
}


# --- Step 14: Top changing annotations (ranked by absolute delta) ---
top_changing <- delta_by_annotation %>%
  dplyr::group_by(tag, Neuron) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_delta = mean(delta, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_delta = mean(abs(delta), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(mean_abs_delta)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 20)

# save csv
write_csv(top_changing, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "top_changing_annotations.csv"))

# Lollipop plot
p_top_changing <- ggplot(
  top_changing,
  aes(x = reorder(tag, mean_abs_delta), y = mean_delta, color = Neuron)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = tag, yend = 0),
    linewidth = 3
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Neuron), size = 3, shape = 21, stroke = 0.3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_color_manual(values = neuron_palette, name = "Neuron") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(iN = "grey60", iDA = "grey80"), name = "Neuron") +
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 annotations with largest change (d50 - d30)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean Δ Lost PPIs"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "lollipop_top_changing_annotations.pdf"),p_top_changing,width = 3,height = 3, device = cairo_pdf)



# --- Step 15: Summary statistics table ---
summary_stats <- timecourse_multi_summary %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Genotype, Neuron) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    d30_lost = n_lost[Day == "d30"],
    d50_lost = n_lost[Day == "d50"],
    delta = d50_lost - d30_lost,
    pct_change = (delta / d30_lost) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(abs(delta)))

# save csv
write_csv(summary_stats, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "summary_statistics.csv"))

message("\nSummary statistics:")
print(summary_stats)



# --- Step 16: Ratio plots (iDA/iN) ---
ratio_data <- timecourse_multi_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(Genotype, Day, Neuron, n_lost) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Neuron,
    values_from = n_lost
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ratio_iDA_iN = iDA / iN
  )

# save csv
write_csv(ratio_data, file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "tables", "ratio_iDA_to_iN.csv"))

# Barplot of ratios
p_ratio <- ggplot(
  ratio_data,
  aes(x = Genotype, y = ratio_iDA_iN, fill = Day)
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = day_palette, name = "Day") +
  labs(
    title = "Ratio of lost PPIs: iDA / iN",
    x = NULL,
    y = "iDA / iN ratio"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

ggsave(file.path(out_dir_timecourse_multi, "plots/global", "bars_ratio_iDA_to_iN.pdf"), p_ratio, width = 3, height = 3, device = cairo_pdf)


# --- Final summary message ---
message("\nResults saved to: ", out_dir_timecourse_multi)
message("  - Genotypes analyzed: ", paste(genotypes, collapse = ", "))
message("  - Timepoints: d30, d50")
message("  - Total edge states computed: ", nrow(timecourse_multi_edge_states))
message("  - Trimers assessed: ", ifelse(exists("timecourse_multi_trimer_states"), "Yes", "No"))
message("  - Complexes assessed: ", ifelse(exists("complex_multi_timecourse_summary"), "Yes", "No"))
message("\nKey outputs:")
message("  - Global comparison plots in: plots/global/")
message("  - Per-genotype plots in: plots/by_genotype/")
message("  - Summary tables in: tables/")
```

```{r}
1
# --- Step 0: create outdirs and setup of environment 
# Setup output directories
out_dir_hela_ppi <- "/Users/felix/Documents/PostDoc/Harvard/03_LSD-PD/Proteomics/d50_diff132/day50/PPI/HeLaPPI"
dir.create(out_dir_hela_ppi, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```
