dir.create(file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "plots/multimer"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "plots/qc"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

dir.create(file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "tables/multimer"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Parameters
drop_thresh <- -0.5
gain_up_thresh <- 0.5
conf_bins <- c(0, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, 1)
control_outlier_thresh <- 0.4


# Helper functions
.make_undirected_key <- function(a, b) {
  ifelse(a <= b, paste(a, b, sep = "::"), paste(b, a, sep = "::"))
}

.bin_conf <- function(x, bins) {
  cut(x, breaks = bins, include.lowest = TRUE, right = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 4: Compute PPI edge states per KO ---
message("\n=== Computing PPI edge states per KO ===")

# First, check for duplicates in baseline_edges_hela
message("Checking baseline_edges_hela for duplicate keys...")
baseline_dup_check <- baseline_edges_hela %>%
  dplyr::count(key) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(baseline_dup_check) > 0) {
  message("WARNING: Found ", nrow(baseline_dup_check), " duplicate keys in baseline_edges_hela")
  message("Deduplicating baseline edges...")
  baseline_edges_hela <- baseline_edges_hela %>%
    dplyr::distinct(key, .keep_all = TRUE)
  message("Baseline edges after deduplication: ", nrow(baseline_edges_hela))
}

# Expand baseline to all KO contexts
ko_list <- unique(hela_prot_long$genotype)

baseline_expanded_hela <- baseline_edges_hela %>%
  tidyr::crossing(genotype = ko_list)

message("Baseline expanded rows: ", nrow(baseline_expanded_hela))
message("Expected rows: ", nrow(baseline_edges_hela), " * ", length(ko_list), " = ", nrow(baseline_edges_hela) * length(ko_list))

# Check for duplicates after expansion
expand_dup_check <- baseline_expanded_hela %>%
  dplyr::count(key, genotype) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(expand_dup_check) > 0) {
  message("ERROR: Found ", nrow(expand_dup_check), " duplicate key-genotype pairs after expansion!")
  message("This should not happen. Deduplicating...")
  baseline_expanded_hela <- baseline_expanded_hela %>%
    dplyr::distinct(key, genotype, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# Join proteome data for both partners
hela_edge_states <- baseline_expanded_hela %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    hela_prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, genotype, log2FC),
    by = c("Gene1" = "Genes", "genotype"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"  # Each edge-genotype should match one Gene1 measurement
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(dA = log2FC) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    hela_prot_long %>% dplyr::select(Genes, genotype, log2FC),
    by = c("Gene2" = "Genes", "genotype"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"  # Each edge-genotype should match one Gene2 measurement
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(dB = log2FC) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    state = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(dA) & dA < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
      !is.na(dB) & dB < drop_thresh ~ "lost",
      (!is.na(dA) | !is.na(dB))     ~ "retained",
      TRUE                          ~ "unknown"
    ),
    # Add organelle pairing info
    OrgPair = ifelse(!is.na(Gene1) & !is.na(Gene2), "same", "cross")  # Simplified for now
  )

# **CRITICAL: Check for duplicates in final edge_states**
message("Checking hela_edge_states for duplicate key-genotype pairs...")
final_dup_check <- hela_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::count(key, genotype) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(final_dup_check) > 0) {
  message("ERROR: Found ", nrow(final_dup_check), " duplicate key-genotype pairs in hela_edge_states!")
  message("Sample duplicates:")
  print(head(final_dup_check, 10))
  
  message("Investigating cause...")
  # Check one example
  example_dup <- final_dup_check[1, ]
  message("Example duplicate: key=", example_dup$key, ", genotype=", example_dup$genotype)
  
  example_rows <- hela_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(key == example_dup$key, genotype == example_dup$genotype)
  message("Number of rows for this example: ", nrow(example_rows))
  print(example_rows)
  
  message("Deduplicating by taking first occurrence...")
  hela_edge_states <- hela_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::distinct(key, genotype, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  message("Rows after deduplication: ", nrow(hela_edge_states))
}

# Add disease class information if available
if (exists("disease_classes_dataframe")) {
  # Deduplicate disease classes first
  disease_classes_clean <- disease_classes_dataframe %>%
    dplyr::distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  hela_edge_states <- hela_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      disease_classes_clean %>% dplyr::rename(genotype = sample),
      by = "genotype",
      relationship = "many-to-one"
    )
}

# Save edge states
write_csv(hela_edge_states, file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "tables", "hela_edge_states.csv"))

message("Final hela_edge_states rows: ", nrow(hela_edge_states))
message("Expected rows: ", nrow(baseline_edges_hela), " * ", length(ko_list), " = ", nrow(baseline_edges_hela) * length(ko_list))

message("\n=== Adding organelle annotations ===")

# Check for existing organelle columns in baseline_edges_hela
existing_org_cols <- grep("_prot[12]\\.(x|y)$", colnames(baseline_edges_hela), value = TRUE)

if (length(existing_org_cols) > 0) {

# Use existing organelle annotations from HeLaWCnMOST_df_annotated

  prot1_annotations <- gene_to_org_hela %>%

  baseline_edges_hela_annotated <- baseline_edges_hela %>%

# Function to determine same organelle
.same_organelle_hela <- function(df, organelle_tags) {
  existing_org1_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot1")
  existing_org2_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags, "_prot2")
  
  # Only use columns that actually exist
  existing_org1_cols <- intersect(existing_org1_cols, colnames(df))
  existing_org2_cols <- intersect(existing_org2_cols, colnames(df))
  
  if (length(existing_org1_cols) == 0 || length(existing_org2_cols) == 0) {
    return(rep("cross", nrow(df)))
  }
  
  prot1_mat <- as.data.frame(df[existing_org1_cols])
  prot2_mat <- as.data.frame(df[existing_org2_cols])
  
  prot1_mat[] <- lapply(prot1_mat, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x)))
  prot2_mat[] <- lapply(prot2_mat, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x)))
  
  shared <- prot1_mat & prot2_mat
  ifelse(rowSums(shared) > 0, "same", "cross")
}

# Extract clean organelle tag names (without _prot1/_prot2 suffix)
org1_cols_clean <- grep("_prot1$", colnames(baseline_edges_hela_annotated), value = TRUE)
organelle_tags_clean <- sub("_prot1$", "", org1_cols_clean)

message("Clean organelle tags: ", length(organelle_tags_clean))

# Create shared organelle mapping
org1_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags_clean, "_prot1")
org2_cols <- paste0(organelle_tags_clean, "_prot2")

# Verify that these columns exist in the annotated dataframe
existing_org1_cols <- intersect(org1_cols, colnames(baseline_edges_hela_annotated))
existing_org2_cols <- intersect(org2_cols, colnames(baseline_edges_hela_annotated))

message("Found ", length(existing_org1_cols), " prot1 organelle columns")
message("Found ", length(existing_org2_cols), " prot2 organelle columns")

# Create shared_long_hela for organelle-specific analysis
shared_long_hela <- {
  if (length(existing_org1_cols) == 0 || length(existing_org2_cols) == 0) {
    message("No organelle columns found, creating empty shared_long_hela")
    data.frame(key = character(0), tag = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    m1 <- baseline_edges_hela_annotated[, existing_org1_cols, drop = FALSE] %>% 
      lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) %>% 
      as.data.frame()
    m2 <- baseline_edges_hela_annotated[, existing_org2_cols, drop = FALSE] %>% 
      lapply(function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x))) %>% 
      as.data.frame()
    
    shared_mat <- as.matrix(m1) & as.matrix(m2)
    
    # Get the organelle tags that actually exist
    existing_tags <- sub("_prot1$", "", existing_org1_cols)
    
    bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(shared_mat)), function(i) {
      idx <- which(shared_mat[i, ])
      if (!length(idx)) return(NULL)
      data.frame(
        key = baseline_edges_hela_annotated$key[i], 
        tag = existing_tags[idx], 
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }))
  }
}

message("Created shared_long_hela with ", nrow(shared_long_hela), " rows")

# Update edge states with organelle pairing
hela_edge_states <- hela_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    OrgPair = .same_organelle_hela(baseline_edges_hela_annotated[match(key, baseline_edges_hela_annotated$key), ], 
                                  organelle_tags_clean)
  )



# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 7: Summary by organelle ---

hela_summary_by_organelle <- hela_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(shared_long_hela, by = "key") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, tag) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_edges = n(),
    n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    fraction_lost = n_lost / n_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_edges >= 10)  # Minimum edge count

# Save organelle summary
write_csv(hela_summary_by_organelle, file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "tables", "hela_summary_by_organelle.csv"))

# --- Step 8: Visualization functions ---
message("\n=== Creating visualization functions ===")

plot_hela_ppi_vulnerability <- function(df_edges,
                                        df_states,
                                        out_dir,
                                        plot_set = c("global_bar", "global_corr", "organelle"),
                                        disease_class_df = NULL,
                                        save = TRUE) {
  
  # Disease class palette
  disease_class_palette <- if (exists("disease_class_palette")) {
    get("disease_class_palette", inherits = TRUE)
  } else {
    c(
      Sphigolipidoses="#D53E4F",
      Mucopolysaccharidoses="#F46D43",
      Glycoproteinoses="#FDAE61",
      Neuronal.ceroid.lipofucinoses="#FEE08B",
      Integral.membrane.protein.disorders="#E6F598",
      PTM.defects="#ABDDA4",
      Lipid.storage.diseases="#66C2A5"
    )
  }
  
  # ----- GLOBAL STACKED BARS -----
  if ("global_bar" %in% plot_set) {
    hela_ppi_global <- df_states %>%
      dplyr::mutate(state = factor(state, levels = c("retained", "lost", "unknown")))
    
    if (!is.null(disease_class_df)) {
      # Fix the many-to-many relationship issue
      disease_class_clean <- disease_class_df %>% 
        dplyr::distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
        dplyr::rename(genotype = sample)
      
      hela_ppi_global <- hela_ppi_global %>%
        dplyr::left_join(disease_class_clean, by = "genotype", relationship = "many-to-one")
    }
    
    hela_ppi_global_sum <- hela_ppi_global %>%
      dplyr::group_by(genotype, state) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
      dplyr::group_by(genotype) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
    
    bar_ppi_global <- ggplot(hela_ppi_global_sum, aes(x = reorder(genotype, -n), y = n, fill = state)) +
      geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(retained = "grey80", lost = "#C51B7D", unknown = "grey50")) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Edges", title = "Edge outcomes per KO (HeLa)") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
      )
    
    if (save) {
      ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", "bars_edge_outcomes_hela.pdf"), 
             bar_ppi_global, width = 8, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
    }
  }
  
  # ----- GLOBAL KO×KO CORRELATION HEATMAP -----
  if ("global_corr" %in% plot_set) {
    lost_df <- df_states %>%
      dplyr::transmute(genotype, key, lost = as.integer(state == "lost"))
    
    if (nrow(lost_df) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
    
    # **FIX: Add deduplication before pivot_wider**
    message("Checking for duplicates in lost_df...")
    dup_check <- lost_df %>% 
      dplyr::count(genotype, key) %>% 
      dplyr::filter(n > 1)
    
    if (nrow(dup_check) > 0) {
      message("WARNING: Found ", nrow(dup_check), " duplicate genotype-key pairs")
      message("Taking mean of duplicates...")
      lost_df <- lost_df %>%
        dplyr::group_by(genotype, key) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(lost = mean(lost, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
    }
    
    # **FIX: Use named list for values_fill**
    lost_wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
      lost_df, 
      names_from = key, 
      values_from = lost, 
      values_fill = list(lost = 0)  # Named list instead of scalar
    )
    
    lost_mat <- as.data.frame(lost_wide)
    rownames(lost_mat) <- lost_mat$genotype
    lost_mat$genotype <- NULL
    
    if (nrow(lost_mat) < 2 || ncol(lost_mat) < 2) return(invisible(NULL))
    
    rho <- suppressWarnings(stats::cor(t(as.matrix(lost_mat)),
                                      method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
    
    # Annotations
    annotation_df <- data.frame(genotype = rownames(rho), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    if (!is.null(disease_class_df)) {
      # Add deduplication for disease_class_df
      disease_class_clean <- disease_class_df %>% 
        dplyr::distinct(sample, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
        dplyr::rename(genotype = sample)
      
      annotation_df <- annotation_df %>%
        dplyr::left_join(disease_class_clean, by = "genotype")
    }
    rownames(annotation_df) <- annotation_df$genotype
    annotation_df$genotype <- NULL
    
    ann_colors <- NULL
    if ("DiseaseClass" %in% colnames(annotation_df)) {
      present <- unique(stats::na.omit(annotation_df$DiseaseClass))
      present <- intersect(names(disease_class_palette), present)
      if (length(present) > 0) ann_colors <- list(DiseaseClass = disease_class_palette[present])
    }
    
    pheatmap::pheatmap(
      mat = rho,
      scale = "none",
      color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101),
      breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102),
      na_col = "grey90",
      clustering_distance_rows = as.dist(1 - rho),
      clustering_distance_cols = as.dist(1 - rho),
      clustering_method = "ward.D2",
      show_rownames = TRUE,
      show_colnames = TRUE,
      use_raster = FALSE,
      annotation_col = annotation_df,
      annotation_row = annotation_df,
      annotation_colors = ann_colors,
      angle_col = "90",
      main = "KO × KO similarity of lost PPIs (HeLa)",
      fontsize = 6,
      border_color = NA,
      cellheight = 6,
      cellwidth = 6,
      filename = file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", "heatmap_lost_corr_hela.pdf"), 
      width = 10, height = 8
    )
  }
  
  # ----- PER-KO ORGANELLE HEATMAPS -----
  if ("organelle" %in% plot_set) {
    org1_cols <- grep("_prot1$", names(df_edges), value = TRUE)
    org2_cols <- grep("_prot2$", names(df_edges), value = TRUE)
    
    if (length(org1_cols) == 0 || length(org2_cols) == 0) {
      message("No organelle flags found; skipping organelle heatmaps.")
    } else {
      organelle_flags <- sub("_prot1$", "", org1_cols)
      
      # Per-edge organelle membership
      edges_org_flags <- df_edges %>%
        dplyr::select(key, dplyr::all_of(org1_cols), dplyr::all_of(org2_cols))
      
      m1 <- as.data.frame(edges_org_flags[, org1_cols, drop = FALSE])
      m2 <- as.data.frame(edges_org_flags[, org2_cols, drop = FALSE])
      m1[] <- lapply(m1, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x)))
      m2[] <- lapply(m2, function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), FALSE, as.logical(x)))
      shared_mat <- as.matrix(m1) & as.matrix(m2)
      
      shared_long <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(shared_mat)), function(i) {
        idx <- which(shared_mat[i, ])
        if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)
        data.frame(key = edges_org_flags$key[i],
                  organelle = organelle_flags[idx],
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      })
      shared_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(shared_long)
      
      # Skip organelle analysis if no shared organelles found
      if (is.null(shared_long) || nrow(shared_long) == 0) {
        message("No shared organelles found; skipping organelle heatmap.")
        return(invisible(NULL))
      }
      
      # Deduplicate shared_long
      shared_long <- shared_long %>% dplyr::distinct(key, organelle)
      
      # Fraction lost per KO × organelle
      frac_by_ko_org <- df_states %>%
        dplyr::select(key, genotype, state) %>%
        dplyr::inner_join(shared_long, by = "key", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
        dplyr::group_by(genotype, organelle) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(
          n_tot = dplyr::n(),
          n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
          fraction_lost = ifelse(n_tot > 0, n_lost / n_tot, NA_real_),
          .groups = "drop"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(n_tot >= 5)  # Minimum edge count
      
      if (nrow(frac_by_ko_org) > 0) {
        # **COMPLETE ALTERNATIVE: Build matrix manually without pivot_wider**
        frac_by_ko_org_clean <- frac_by_ko_org %>%
          dplyr::ungroup() %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            genotype = as.character(genotype),
            organelle = as.character(organelle),
            fraction_lost = as.numeric(fraction_lost)
          ) %>%
          dplyr::group_by(genotype, organelle) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(
            fraction_lost = mean(fraction_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop"
          ) %>%
          dplyr::filter(!is.na(fraction_lost))
        
        message("Rows after cleaning: ", nrow(frac_by_ko_org_clean))
        
        # Build matrix manually
        all_genotypes <- unique(frac_by_ko_org_clean$genotype)
        all_organelles <- unique(frac_by_ko_org_clean$organelle)
        
        # Initialize matrix with zeros
        hm_mat <- matrix(0, 
                         nrow = length(all_genotypes), 
                         ncol = length(all_organelles),
                         dimnames = list(all_genotypes, all_organelles))
        
        # Fill matrix
        for (i in seq_len(nrow(frac_by_ko_org_clean))) {
          row_idx <- frac_by_ko_org_clean$genotype[i]
          col_idx <- frac_by_ko_org_clean$organelle[i]
          hm_mat[row_idx, col_idx] <- frac_by_ko_org_clean$fraction_lost[i]
        }
        
        # Only create heatmap if we have enough data
        if (nrow(hm_mat) >= 2 && ncol(hm_mat) >= 2) {
          pheatmap::pheatmap(
            mat = hm_mat,
            scale = "none",
            color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100),
            breaks = seq(0, 1, length.out = 101),
            na_col = "grey90",
            cluster_rows = TRUE,
            cluster_cols = TRUE,
            show_rownames = TRUE,
            show_colnames = TRUE,
            use_raster = FALSE,
            angle_col = "90",
            main = "Fraction lost by organelle (HeLa)",
            fontsize = 6,
            cellwidth = 8,
            cellheight = 8,
            border_color = NA,
            filename = file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", "heatmap_organelle_fraction_lost_hela.pdf"), 
            width = 12, height = 10
          )
        } else {
          message("Insufficient dimensions for heatmap (need >= 2 rows and cols); skipping.")
        }
      } else {
        message("No organelle data with sufficient edges found; skipping organelle heatmap.")
      }
    }
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 10: Trimer Analysis for HeLa ---
message("\n=== Trimer analysis for HeLa ===")

if (exists("trimers_baseline")) {
  # Convert HeLa edge states to gene-based keys
  hela_edge_genes <- hela_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::select(key, Gene1, Gene2, genotype, state) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(key_gene = .make_undirected_key(Gene1, Gene2))
  
  # Assess trimer states
  assess_hela_trimers <- function(baseline_trimers, edge_states) {
    trimers_with_keys <- baseline_trimers %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        key_AB = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneB),
        key_BC = .make_undirected_key(GeneB, GeneC),
        key_AC = .make_undirected_key(GeneA, GeneC)
      )
    
    # Expand to all KOs
    ko_combos <- edge_states %>% dplyr::distinct(genotype)
    trimers_expanded <- trimers_with_keys %>% tidyr::crossing(ko_combos)
    
    # Join edge states
    trimers_states <- trimers_expanded %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, genotype, state),
        by = c("key_AB" = "key_gene", "genotype")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(state_AB = state) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, genotype, state),
        by = c("key_BC" = "key_gene", "genotype")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(state_BC = state) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        edge_states %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, genotype, state),
        by = c("key_AC" = "key_gene", "genotype")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::rename(state_AC = state) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        state_AB = tidyr::replace_na(state_AB, "retained"),
        state_BC = tidyr::replace_na(state_BC, "retained"),
        state_AC = tidyr::replace_na(state_AC, "retained"),
        n_lost = (state_AB == "lost") + (state_BC == "lost") + (state_AC == "lost"),
        trimer_state = dplyr::case_when(
          n_lost >= 2 ~ "broken",
          n_lost == 1 ~ "partial",
          n_lost == 0 ~ "intact",
          TRUE ~ "unknown"
        )
      )
    
    return(trimers_states)
  }
  
  hela_trimer_states <- assess_hela_trimers(
    baseline_trimers = trimers_baseline,
    edge_states = hela_edge_genes
  )
  
  # Save trimer states
  write_csv(hela_trimer_states, file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "tables/multimer", "hela_trimer_states.csv"))
  
  # Summary
  hela_trimer_summary <- hela_trimer_states %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_intact = sum(trimer_state == "intact", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_broken = sum(trimer_state == "broken", na.rm = TRUE),
      n_partial = sum(trimer_state == "partial", na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_broken = n_broken / n_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(frac_broken))
  
  # Save trimer summary
  write_csv(hela_trimer_summary, file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "tables/multimer", "hela_trimer_summary.csv"))
  
  message("Trimer breakage summary (top 10):")
  print(head(hela_trimer_summary, 10))
  
  # Barplot - broken trimers per KO
  p_trimer_bar <- ggplot(hela_trimer_summary, 
                        aes(x = reorder(genotype, -n_broken), y = n_broken)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#C51B7D", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_broken), vjust = -0.5, size = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "Broken trimers per KO (HeLa)",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of broken trimers"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "plots/multimer", "bars_broken_trimers_hela.pdf"), p_trimer_bar, width = 8, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Affected trimers by organelle
  trimer_affected_org <- hela_trimer_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(trimer_state %in% c("broken", "partial")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shared_long_hela, by = c("key_AB" = "key")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(tag_AB = tag) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shared_long_hela, by = c("key_BC" = "key")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(tag_BC = tag) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shared_long_hela, by = c("key_AC" = "key")) %>%
    dplyr::rename(tag_AC = tag) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(tag_AB, tag_BC, tag_AC),
      names_to = "edge_type",
      values_to = "tag"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(genotype, trimer_id, tag, trimer_state) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, tag) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_affected = n(),
      n_broken = sum(trimer_state == "broken"),
      n_partial = sum(trimer_state == "partial"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(n_affected))
  
  # Save organelle-specific trimer results
  write_csv(trimer_affected_org, file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "tables/multimer", "hela_trimers_by_organelle.csv"))
}



# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 11: Complex Analysis for HeLa ---
message("\n=== Complex analysis for HeLa ===")

if (exists("complexes_summary") && exists("complex_edges_df")) {
  
  # Expand complexes to all KOs
  ko_combos <- hela_edge_genes %>% dplyr::distinct(genotype)
  
  complexes_expanded_hela <- complex_edges_df %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, community_id, key_gene) %>%
    tidyr::crossing(ko_combos)
  
  # Join edge states
  complexes_hela_states <- complexes_expanded_hela %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      hela_edge_genes %>% dplyr::select(key_gene, genotype, state),
      by = c("key_gene", "genotype")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      state = tidyr::replace_na(state, "retained"),
      edge_lost = state == "lost"
    )
  
  # Aggregate per complex × KO
  complex_hela_summary <- complexes_hela_states %>%
    dplyr::group_by(complex_id, genotype) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_edges_total = n(),
      n_edges_lost = sum(edge_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_edges_lost = n_edges_lost / n_edges_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      complexes_summary %>% dplyr::select(complex_id, n_proteins, organelle),
      by = "complex_id"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      complex_state = dplyr::case_when(
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.75 ~ "disrupted",
        frac_edges_lost >= 0.25 ~ "partial",
        TRUE ~ "intact"
      )
    )
  
  # Save complex states
  write_csv(complex_hela_summary, file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "tables/multimer", "hela_complex_states.csv"))
  
  # Summary statistics
  complex_disruption_hela <- complex_hela_summary %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_complexes = n(),
      n_intact = sum(complex_state == "intact"),
      n_disrupted = sum(complex_state == "disrupted"),
      n_partial = sum(complex_state == "partial"),
      frac_disrupted = n_disrupted / n_complexes,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(frac_disrupted))
  
  # Save disruption summary
  write_csv(complex_disruption_hela, file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "tables/multimer", "hela_complex_disruption_summary.csv"))
  
  message("Complex disruption summary (top 10):")
  print(head(complex_disruption_hela, 10))
  
  # Barplot - disrupted complexes per KO
  p_complex_bar <- ggplot(complex_disruption_hela, 
                         aes(x = reorder(genotype, -n_disrupted), y = n_disrupted)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#C51B7D", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_disrupted), vjust = -0.5, size = 2) +
    labs(
      title = "Disrupted complexes per KO (HeLa)",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Number of disrupted complexes"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "plots/multimer", "bars_disrupted_complexes_hela.pdf"), 
         p_complex_bar, width = 8, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Per organelle analysis
  complex_org_hela <- complex_hela_summary %>%
    dplyr::filter(complex_state == "disrupted", organelle != "Other") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, organelle) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_disrupted = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(n_disrupted))
  
  # Save organelle-specific complex results
  write_csv(complex_org_hela, file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "tables/multimer", "hela_complexes_by_organelle.csv"))
  
  # Heatmap - disrupted complexes by organelle × KO
  if (nrow(complex_org_hela) > 0) {
    complex_org_wide <- complex_org_hela %>%
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = organelle,
        values_from = n_disrupted,
        values_fill = 0
      )
    
    if (nrow(complex_org_wide) >= 2 && ncol(complex_org_wide) >= 3) {
      complex_org_mat <- as.matrix(complex_org_wide[, -1])
      rownames(complex_org_mat) <- complex_org_wide$genotype
      
      pheatmap::pheatmap(
        complex_org_mat,
        scale = "none",
        color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#C51B7D"))(100),
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        cluster_cols = TRUE,
        show_rownames = TRUE,
        show_colnames = TRUE,
        border_color = NA,
        fontsize = 6,
        cellwidth = 10,
        cellheight = 10,
        main = "Disrupted complexes by organelle (HeLa)",
        filename = file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "plots/multimer", "heatmap_disrupted_complexes_by_organelle_hela.pdf"),
        width = 12, height = 10
      )
    }
  }
}



# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 12: Organelle-specific stacked bars ---
message("\n=== Creating organelle-specific stacked bars ===")

# Plot organelle stacked bars for HeLa
plot_hela_organelle_bars <- function(df_states, shared_long, annotation_classes, 
                                    annotation_colors, out_dir) {
  
  if (is.null(shared_long) || nrow(shared_long) == 0) {
    message("No shared organelle tags found; skipping organelle stacked bars.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Tag -> class map
  tag_map <- lapply(names(annotation_classes), function(cls) {
    tags <- annotation_classes[[cls]]
    data.frame(tag = tags, class = cls, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }) %>% dplyr::bind_rows()
  
  # Map tags -> classes and summarize per genotype/class
  shared_class <- shared_long %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(tag_map, by = "tag") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(key, class)
  
  loss_by_class <- df_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same") %>%
    dplyr::select(key, genotype, state) %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(shared_class, by = "key") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(genotype, class) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_tot = dplyr::n(),
      n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
      frac_lost = ifelse(n_tot > 0, n_lost / n_tot, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Restrict palette to present classes
  present_classes <- unique(loss_by_class$class)
  class_cols <- annotation_colors[names(annotation_colors) %in% present_classes]
  class_cols <- class_cols[present_classes]
  
  # Plot counts: stacked by organelle class
  p_counts <- ggplot(loss_by_class, aes(x = reorder(genotype, -n_lost), y = n_lost, fill = class)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols, drop = FALSE, name = "Organelle") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Lost PPIs (count)", title = "Lost PPIs by organelle (HeLa)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", "bars_organelle_lost_counts_hela.pdf"), p_counts, width = 8, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Plot fractions: composition across organelle classes per genotype
  p_frac <- ggplot(loss_by_class, aes(x = reorder(genotype, -n_lost), y = n_lost, fill = class)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, position = "fill", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = class_cols, drop = FALSE, name = "Organelle") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of lost PPIs", title = "Composition of lost PPIs by organelle (HeLa)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "plots/global", "bars_organelle_lost_fraction_hela.pdf"), p_frac, width = 8, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# Call organelle plotting function if annotation classes are available
if (exists("annotation_classes_corrgeno") && exists("annotation_class_colors_corrgeno")) {
  plot_hela_organelle_bars(
    df_states = hela_edge_states,
    shared_long = shared_long_hela,
    annotation_classes = annotation_classes_corrgeno,
    annotation_colors = annotation_class_colors_corrgeno,
    out_dir = out_dir_hela_ppi
  )
}




# ---------------------------------------------------
# --- Step 13: Per-KO detailed analysis ---
message("\n=== Creating per-KO detailed analysis ===")

# Create plots for all most affected KOs
top_affected_kos <- hela_summary_global %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 34) %>%
  dplyr::pull(genotype)

for (ko in top_affected_kos) {
  message("Processing detailed analysis for ", ko)
  
  # KO-specific edge states
  ko_edges <- hela_edge_states %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == ko)
  
  # By organelle breakdown
  ko_by_organelle <- ko_edges %>%
    dplyr::filter(OrgPair == "same") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(shared_long_hela, by = "key") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(tag, state) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(state %in% c("lost", "retained"))
  
  if (nrow(ko_by_organelle) > 0) {
    # Stacked bar for this KO
    p_ko_organelle <- ggplot(ko_by_organelle, aes(x = reorder(tag, -n), y = n, fill = state)) +
      geom_col(position = "stack", color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(retained = "grey70", lost = "#C51B7D"), name = "State") +
      labs(
        title = paste("PPI state per organelle –", ko),
        x = NULL,
        y = "Number of PPIs"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "top"
      )
    
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "plots/by_ko", paste0(ko, "_bars_organelle_state.pdf")), p_ko_organelle, width = 6, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
  }
}

# --- Step 14: QC plots for PPI confidence by organelle ---
message("\n=== Creating QC plots for PPI confidence by organelle ===")

# QC plots similar to neuronal analysis
ppi_qc_hela <- baseline_edges_hela_annotated %>%

  dplyr::filter(!is.na(tag))

message("PPI QC data prepared: ", nrow(ppi_qc_hela), " rows")

# Generate organelle colors
n_tags_hela <- length(unique(ppi_qc_hela$tag))
organelle_colors_hela <- colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3"))(n_tags_hela)
names(organelle_colors_hela) <- sort(unique(ppi_qc_hela$tag))

# Plotting function for confidence distributions
plot_hela_confidence_distribution <- function(df, score_col, out_dir, org_colors) {
  
  df_plot <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(!!sym(score_col)))
  
  if (nrow(df_plot) == 0) {
    message("No data for ", score_col, "; skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  
  # Density plot by organelle
  p_density <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = !!sym(score_col), fill = tag)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, name = "Organelle") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "distribution by organelle (HeLa)"),
      x = score_col,
      y = "Density"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm")
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("density_", score_col, "_by_organelle_hela.pdf")), p_density, width = 8, height = 4, device = cairo_pdf)
  
  # Box plot by organelle
  p_box <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = reorder(tag, !!sym(score_col), median), 
                               y = !!sym(score_col), fill = tag)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = org_colors, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste(score_col, "by organelle (HeLa, ordered by median)"),
      x = NULL,
      y = score_col
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("boxplot_", score_col, "_by_organelle_hela.pdf")), p_box, width = 8, height = 4.5, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# Apply to all prediction scores
for (score in c("RFprob", "AFprob", "AFMprob", "Predictome_conf")) {
  plot_hela_confidence_distribution(
    ppi_qc_hela, 
    score, 
    file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "plots/qc"),
    organelle_colors_hela
  )
}

    ggsave(file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "plots/qc", "bubble_AFprob_vs_PredictomeConf_byOrganelle_hela.pdf"), p_qc_bubble_af_hela, width = 7, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
    
    # Save summary statistics
    write_csv(qc_tag_summary_hela, file.path(out_dir_hela_ppi, "tables", "qc_confidence_by_organelle_summary.csv"))
    
    message("Created bubble plots for PPI confidence by organelle")

# --- Step 1: Load and harmonize PPI data from all cell types ---
message("\n=== Loading PPI data from all cell types ===")

neuronal_edge_states <- ko_edge_states %>%

# save combined edge state df
write_csv(all_edge_states, file.path(out_dir_ppi_comp, "tables", "iN_iDA_Hela_combined_edges.csv"))

message("Genotypes: ", paste(unique(all_edge_states$genotype), collapse = ", "))

# Find common genotypes across all cell types
common_genotypes <- all_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::distinct(genotype, cell_type) %>%

message("\n=== Computing global PPI loss per KO × cell type ===")

global_ppi_loss <- all_edge_states %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, cell_type) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    total_edges = n(),
    n_lost = sum(state == "lost", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_retained = sum(state == "retained", na.rm = TRUE),
    frac_lost = n_lost / total_edges,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = c("iN", "iDA", "HeLa"))
  )

# save csv file of lossed PPIs across matched KOs 
write_csv(global_ppi_loss, file.path(out_dir_ppi_comp, "tables", "global_ppi_loss_all_celltypes.csv"))

message("Global PPI loss summary (top 10 by total lost):")
global_ppi_loss %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_lost = sum(n_lost), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(total_lost)) %>%

  dplyr::filter(genotype %in% common_genotypes) %>%

    cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = c("iDA", "iN", "HeLa"))
  ) %>%

# Create function for streamgraph with different types
create_streamgraph <- function(data, stream_type, filename) {
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = genotype, y = n_lost, fill = cell_type)) +
    geom_stream(type = stream_type, sorting = "inside_out", lwd = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = streamgraph_palette, name = "Cell Type") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = abs) +

      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_comp, "plots/dimers", filename), p, width = 5, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# Function to create organelle streamgraph
create_organelle_streamgraph <- function(ko_data, ko_name, stream_type, filename) {
  p <- ggplot(ko_data, aes(x = tag, y = n_lost, fill = cell_type)) +
    geom_stream(type = stream_type, sorting = "inside_out", lwd = 0.25) +

    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_comp, "plots/dimers", filename), p, width = 8, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
}

for (ko in top_kos) {

# --- Step 7: Matched vs unique lost PPIs ---
message("\n=== Computing matched vs unique lost PPIs ===")

# Create PPI × cell_type matrix for each genotype
compute_ppi_matching <- function(edges_df, genotype_name) {
  
  ko_edges <- edges_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == genotype_name, state == "lost") %>%
    dplyr::select(key, cell_type) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  if (nrow(ko_edges) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Pivot to wide format
  ppi_matrix <- ko_edges %>%
    dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = cell_type,
      values_from = present,
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  # Classify PPIs
  ppi_classified <- ppi_matrix %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_celltypes = iN + iDA + HeLa,
      pattern = dplyr::case_when(
        n_celltypes == 3 ~ "All_three",
        n_celltypes == 2 & iN == 1 & iDA == 1 ~ "iN_iDA",
        n_celltypes == 2 & iN == 1 & HeLa == 1 ~ "iN_HeLa",
        n_celltypes == 2 & iDA == 1 & HeLa == 1 ~ "iDA_HeLa",
        n_celltypes == 1 & iN == 1 ~ "iN_only",
        n_celltypes == 1 & iDA == 1 ~ "iDA_only",
        n_celltypes == 1 & HeLa == 1 ~ "HeLa_only",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      ),
      genotype = genotype_name
    )
  
  return(ppi_classified)
}

# Apply to all common genotypes

# --- Step 9: Trimer analysis across cell types ---

# Function to create trimer streamgraph
create_trimer_streamgraph <- function(data, stream_type, filename) {
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = genotype, y = n_broken, fill = cell_type)) +
    geom_stream(type = stream_type, sorting = "inside_out", lwd = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = streamgraph_palette, name = "Cell Type") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = abs) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Broken trimers per KO across cell types (", stream_type, ")"),
      subtitle = "Neurons vs HeLa",
      x = "Genotype",
      y = "Number of broken trimers"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_comp, "plots/trimers", filename), p, width = 5, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
}

# Create all three types

# --- Step 10: Trimer matching analysis ---
message("\n=== Computing trimer matching patterns ===")

compute_trimer_matching <- function(trimer_df, genotype_name) {
  
  ko_trimers <- trimer_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == genotype_name, trimer_state == "broken") %>%
    dplyr::select(trimer_id, cell_type) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  if (nrow(ko_trimers) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  trimer_matrix <- ko_trimers %>%
    dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = cell_type,
      values_from = present,
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  # Check which columns actually exist before referencing them
  has_iN <- "iN" %in% colnames(trimer_matrix)
  has_iDA <- "iDA" %in% colnames(trimer_matrix)
  has_HeLa <- "HeLa" %in% colnames(trimer_matrix)
  
  # Add missing columns as 0
  if (!has_iN) trimer_matrix$iN <- 0
  if (!has_iDA) trimer_matrix$iDA <- 0
  if (!has_HeLa) trimer_matrix$HeLa <- 0
  
  trimer_classified <- trimer_matrix %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_celltypes = iN + iDA + HeLa,
      pattern = dplyr::case_when(
        n_celltypes == 3 ~ "All_three",
        n_celltypes == 2 & iN == 1 & iDA == 1 ~ "iN_iDA",
        n_celltypes == 2 & iN == 1 & HeLa == 1 ~ "iN_HeLa",
        n_celltypes == 2 & iDA == 1 & HeLa == 1 ~ "iDA_HeLa",
        n_celltypes == 1 & iN == 1 ~ "iN_only",
        n_celltypes == 1 & iDA == 1 ~ "iDA_only",
        n_celltypes == 1 & HeLa == 1 ~ "HeLa_only",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      ),
      genotype = genotype_name
    )
  
  return(trimer_classified)
}

trimer_matching_all <- lapply(common_genotypes, function(ko) {
  compute_trimer_matching(trimer_states_all, ko)
}) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows()

  scale_fill_manual(values = pattern_colors, name = "Breakage Pattern") +
  labs(
    title = "Trimer breakage patterns across cell types",

    panel.grid = element_blank(),

compute_complex_matching <- function(complex_df, genotype_name) {
  
  ko_complexes <- complex_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == genotype_name, complex_state == "disrupted") %>%
    dplyr::select(complex_id, cell_type) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()
  
  if (nrow(ko_complexes) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  complex_matrix <- ko_complexes %>%
    dplyr::mutate(present = 1) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = cell_type,
      values_from = present,
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  # Check which columns actually exist before referencing them
  has_iN <- "iN" %in% colnames(complex_matrix)
  has_iDA <- "iDA" %in% colnames(complex_matrix)
  has_HeLa <- "HeLa" %in% colnames(complex_matrix)
  
  # Add missing columns as 0
  if (!has_iN) complex_matrix$iN <- 0
  if (!has_iDA) complex_matrix$iDA <- 0
  if (!has_HeLa) complex_matrix$HeLa <- 0
  
  complex_classified <- complex_matrix %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      n_celltypes = iN + iDA + HeLa,
      pattern = dplyr::case_when(
        n_celltypes == 3 ~ "All_three",
        n_celltypes == 2 & iN == 1 & iDA == 1 ~ "iN_iDA",
        n_celltypes == 2 & iN == 1 & HeLa == 1 ~ "iN_HeLa",
        n_celltypes == 2 & iDA == 1 & HeLa == 1 ~ "iDA_HeLa",
        n_celltypes == 1 & iN == 1 ~ "iN_only",
        n_celltypes == 1 & iDA == 1 ~ "iDA_only",
        n_celltypes == 1 & HeLa == 1 ~ "HeLa_only",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      ),
      genotype = genotype_name
    )
  
  return(complex_classified)
}

message("\n=== Creating mean organelle loss plots per KO ===")

# Compute mean loss per organelle across cell types
mean_org_loss <- ppi_loss_by_organelle %>%
  dplyr::group_by(genotype, tag) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_lost = mean(n_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_lost = sd(n_lost, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create plots for top KOs
for (ko in top_kos) {
  
  ko_data <- ppi_loss_by_organelle %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == ko)
  
  ko_mean_data <- mean_org_loss %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype == ko) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(mean_lost)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 20)
  
  if (nrow(ko_data) == 0) next
  
  # Individual cell type bars with mean overlay
  p_org_mean <- ggplot() +
    geom_col(data = ko_data, aes(x = reorder(tag, -n_lost), y = n_lost, fill = cell_type),
             position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.7, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2) +
    geom_point(data = ko_mean_data, aes(x = tag, y = mean_lost),
               shape = 23, size = 3, fill = "red", color = "black", stroke = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(data = ko_mean_data, aes(x = tag, ymin = mean_lost - sd_lost, ymax = mean_lost + sd_lost),
                  width = 0.2, color = "red", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = streamgraph_palette, name = "Cell Type") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Mean PPI loss per organelle –", ko),
      subtitle = "Red diamonds show mean ± SD across cell types",
      x = "Organelle",
      y = "Number of lost PPIs"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir_ppi_comp, "plots/dimers", paste0("bars_mean_organelle_loss_", ko, ".pdf")), p_org_mean, width = 10, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)
}

message("\n=== Creating correlation heatmaps ===")

# PPI loss correlation
ppi_loss_wide <- global_ppi_loss %>%
  dplyr::select(genotype, cell_type, n_lost) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cell_type, values_from = n_lost, values_fill = 0)

ppi_cor_mat <- cor(ppi_loss_wide[, -1], method = "spearman")

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  ppi_cor_mat,
  display_numbers = TRUE,
  number_format = "%.2f",
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(101),
  breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 102),
  main = "PPI loss correlation across cell types",
  fontsize = 8,
  cellwidth = 40,
  cellheight = 40,
  border_color = "black",
  filename = file.path(out_dir_ppi_comp, "plots/dimers", "heatmap_ppi_loss_correlation.pdf"),
  width = 4, height = 3.5
)
